import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)

    orders = db["orders"]
    items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    # Только заказы, совершённые до seed_time
    valid_orders = orders.loc[
        orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time, "order_id"
    ]
    valid_orders = set(valid_orders)

    # Позиции заказов: ts = момент покупки -> до seed_time
    fi = items[
        items["ts"].notna()
        & (items["ts"] < seed_time)
        & items["order_id"].isin(valid_orders)
    ].copy()

    base = pd.DataFrame({"product_id": entity_ids}).set_index("product_id")

    # --------------------------
    # 1. Продажи
    # --------------------------
    sales_agg = fi.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_items=("order_item_id", "count"),
        total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        unique_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
        first_sale_ts=("ts", "min"),
        last_sale_ts=("ts", "max"),
    ).reset_index()

    sales_agg["days_since_first_sale"] = (seed_time - sales_agg["first_sale_ts"]).dt.days
    sales_agg["days_since_last_sale"] = (seed_time - sales_agg["last_sale_ts"]).dt.days
    sales_agg = sales_agg.drop(columns=["first_sale_ts", "last_sale_ts"])

    for col_name, cutoff in [
        ("orders_30d", seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)),
        ("orders_60d", seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=60)),
        ("orders_90d", seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)),
        ("orders_180d", seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)),
    ]:
        w = fi[fi["ts"] >= cutoff].groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique()
        sales_agg[col_name] = sales_agg["product_id"].map(w).fillna(0)

    sales_agg["ratio_30_to_90"] = sales_agg["orders_30d"] / (sales_agg["orders_90d"] + 1e-9)
    sales_agg["ratio_60_to_90"] = sales_agg["orders_60d"] / (sales_agg["orders_90d"] + 1e-9)
    sales_agg["rev_90d"] = fi[fi["ts"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)].groupby(
        "product_id"
    )["price"].sum()
    sales_agg["rev_90d"] = sales_agg["product_id"].map(
        fi[fi["ts"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)].groupby("product_id")["price"].sum()
    ).fillna(0.0)

    sales_agg = sales_agg.set_index("product_id")
    base = base.join(sales_agg, how="left")

    # --------------------------
    # 2. Отзывы (только созданные до seed_time)
    # --------------------------
    fr = reviews[
        reviews["order_id"].isin(valid_orders)
        & reviews["review_creation_date"].notna()
        & (reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time)
    ].copy()

    rp = fr.merge(fi[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates(), on="order_id", how="inner")

    review_agg = rp.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_reviews=("review_id", "nunique"),
        avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        std_review_score=("review_score", "std"),
        avg_review_lag_days=(
            "review_creation_date",
            lambda x: (x - x.index.to_series().astype("datetime64[ns]").min()).mean().days
            if len(x) > 0
            else 0,
        ),
    )
    review_agg = review_agg.drop(columns=["avg_review_lag_days"])
    base = base.join(review_agg, how="left")

    # Свежие отзывы (последние 90 дней)
    fr_recent = fr[fr["review_creation_date"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)]
    rp_recent = fr_recent.merge(fi[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates(),
                                on="order_id", how="inner")
    rev_recent = rp_recent.groupby("product_id")["review_score"].agg(["count", "mean"])
    rev_recent.columns = ["reviews_90d", "avg_review_score_90d"]
    base = base.join(rev_recent, how="left")

    # --------------------------
    # 3. Платежи (только по заказам, случившимся до seed_time; payment ts уже учтён через ts заказа)
    # --------------------------
    fp = payments[payments["order_id"].isin(valid_orders)].copy()
    # Отфильтруем платежи, у которых ts есть и он из будущего (защита)
    fp = fp[fp["ts"].isna() | (fp["ts"] < seed_time)]
    pp = fp.merge(fi[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates(), on="order_id", how="inner")

    payment_agg = pp.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_payments=("payment_sequential", "count"),
        avg_payment_value=("payment_value", "mean"),
        avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
    )
    ctype = pp.groupby("product_id")["payment_type"].agg(
        lambda x: x.mode().iloc[0] if not x.mode().empty else "unknown"
    )
    payment_agg["payment_type_code"] = pd.factorize(ctype)[0]
    base = base.join(payment_agg, how="left")

    # --------------------------
    # 4. Доставка: используем только даты, уже известные к seed_time
    # --------------------------
    prod_orders = fi[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates().merge(
        orders, on="order_id", how="left"
    )

    # Каждое событие учитываем, только если его дата уже наступила (< seed_time)
    for src, tgt in [
        ("order_approved_at", "app"),
        ("order_delivered_carrier_date", "carr"),
        ("order_delivered_customer_date", "cust"),
    ]:
        known = prod_orders[src].notna() & (prod_orders[src] < seed_time)
        col = tgt + "_delay"
        prod_orders[col] = np.where(
            known,
            (prod_orders[src] - prod_orders["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0,
            np.nan,
        )

    known_est = prod_orders["order_estimated_delivery_date"].notna()
    prod_orders["est_gap"] = np.where(
        known_est,
        (prod_orders["order_estimated_delivery_date"] - prod_orders["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.days,
        np.nan,
    )

    known_del = prod_orders["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna() & (
        prod_orders["order_delivered_customer_date"] < seed_time
    )
    prod_orders["on_time"] = np.where(
        known_del & prod_orders["order_estimated_delivery_date"].notna(),
        (prod_orders["order_delivered_customer_date"]
         <= prod_orders["order_estimated_delivery_date"]).astype(float),
        np.nan,
    )

    delivery_agg = prod_orders.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_approval_delay=("app_delay", "mean"),
        avg_carrier_delay=("carr_delay", "mean"),
        avg_delivery_days=("cust_delay", "mean"),
        avg_estimated_days=("est_gap", "mean"),
        on_time_rate=("on_time", "mean"),
    )
    base = base.join(delivery_agg, how="left")

    # Доля заказов с известным статусом delivered на момент seed_time
    delivered = prod_orders["order_status"].eq("delivered")
    base["delivered_rate"] = prod_orders.assign(d=delivered).groupby("product_id")["d"].mean()

    # --------------------------
    # 5. Заполнение пропусков
    # --------------------------
    count_like = [
        "total_orders", "total_items", "total_revenue", "total_freight",
        "unique_sellers", "orders_30d", "orders_60d", "orders_90d", "orders_180d",
        "total_reviews", "reviews_90d", "total_payments", "rev_90d",
    ]
    for c in count_like:
        if c in base.columns:
            base[c] = base[c].fillna(0)

    neutral_fill = 0.0
    for c in base.columns:
        if c not in count_like:
            base[c] = base[c].fillna(neutral_fill)

    max_recency = (seed_time - pd.Timestamp("2016-09-01")).days
    base["days_since_first_sale"] = base["days_since_first_sale"].fillna(max_recency)
    base["days_since_last_sale"] = base["days_since_last_sale"].fillna(max_recency)
    base["payment_type_code"] = base["payment_type_code"].fillna(-1).astype(int)

    # --------------------------
    # 6. Синтетические признаки
    # --------------------------
    base["has_sales_history"] = (base["total_orders"] > 0).astype(int)
    base["recency_score"] = 1.0 / (base["days_since_last_sale"] + 1.0)
    base["frequency_score"] = base["total_orders"] / (base["days_since_first_sale"] + 1.0) * 30.0
    base["monetary_score"] = base["total_revenue"] / (base["total_orders"] + 1.0)
    base["items_per_order"] = base["total_items"] / (base["total_orders"] + 1e-9)
    base["review_rate"] = base["total_reviews"] / (base["total_orders"] + 1e-9)

    base = base.reindex(entity_ids)
    base = base.fillna(0).astype(float)
    return base

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Define historical window (1 year prior to seed time)
    start_hist = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=365)
    
    # Filter order items to historical window
    oi_hist = db["order_items"].query(
        "ts >= @start_hist and ts < @seed_time"
    ).copy()
    
    # Merge with orders for delivery/status data
    oi_orders = oi_hist.merge(
        db["orders"][[
            "order_id", 
            "order_status", 
            "order_delivered_customer_date", 
            "order_estimated_delivery_date"
        ]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    
    # Calculate delivery delay (days)
    oi_orders["delivery_delay_days"] = (
        oi_orders["order_delivered_customer_date"] 
        - oi_orders["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    # Fill NaN for undelivered orders with extreme delay
    oi_orders["delivery_delay_days"] = oi_orders["delivery_delay_days"].fillna(999.0)
    
    # Merge with reviews for score data
    oi_reviews = oi_orders.merge(
        db["reviews"][["order_id", "review_score"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    # Fill missing reviews with neutral score
    oi_reviews["review_score"] = oi_reviews["review_score"].fillna(3.0)
    
    # Aggregate payment data per order
    payments_agg = db["payments"].groupby("order_id").agg(
        total_payment=("payment_value", "sum"),
        avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        frac_credit_card=("payment_type", lambda x: (x == "credit_card").mean())
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Merge payment data into order item dataset
    oi_full = oi_reviews.merge(
        payments_agg,
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    
    # Aggregate features per product_id
    product_features = oi_full.groupby("product_id").agg(
        # Sales volume features
        total_units_sold=("order_item_id", "count"),
        total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
        total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        # Price metrics
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        # Delivery performance
        avg_delivery_delay=("delivery_delay_days", "mean"),
        max_delivery_delay=("delivery_delay_days", "max"),
        # Review quality
        avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        min_review_score=("review_score", "min"),
        frac_5star_reviews=("review_score", lambda x: (x == 5).mean()),
        frac_1star_reviews=("review_score", lambda x: (x == 1).mean()),
        # Payment behavior
        avg_order_total=("total_payment", "mean"),
        avg_payment_installments=("avg_installments", "mean"),
        frac_credit_card_payments=("frac_credit_card", "mean")
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Fill std_price for single-unit products (0 variance)
    product_features["std_price"] = product_features["std_price"].fillna(0.0)
    
    # Create base DataFrame for all requested entity IDs
    result = pd.DataFrame({"product_id": entity_ids}).merge(
        product_features,
        on="product_id",
        how="left"
    )
    
    # Fill missing values for products with no history
    # Review metrics: fill with neutral values
    review_cols = [
        "avg_review_score", 
        "min_review_score", 
        "frac_5star_reviews", 
        "frac_1star_reviews"
    ]
    result[review_cols] = result[review_cols].fillna(3.0)
    
    # Delivery metrics: fill with on-time assumption
    result[["avg_delivery_delay", "max_delivery_delay"]] = result[
        ["avg_delivery_delay", "max_delivery_delay"]
    ].fillna(0.0)
    
    # All other features: fill with 0
    result = result.fillna(0.0)
    
    # Set index to entity IDs and ensure correct order
    result = result.set_index("product_id").reindex(entity_ids)
    
    # Ensure all columns are numeric
    result = result.astype(np.float64)
    
    return result

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    start_hist = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=365)

    oi = db["order_items"]
    orders = db["orders"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    # --- История продаж: только заказы, уже совершённые до seed_time ---
    oi_hist = oi[(oi["ts"] >= start_hist) & (oi["ts"] < seed_time)].copy()

    cols_orders = [
        "order_id",
        "order_status",
        "order_purchase_timestamp",
        "order_delivered_carrier_date",
        "order_delivered_customer_date",
        "order_estimated_delivery_date",
    ]
    oi_orders = oi_hist.merge(orders[cols_orders], on="order_id", how="left")

    # Информация о доставке известна на момент seed_time только если
    # событие уже произошло (дата <= seed_time)
    delivered_known = (
        oi_orders["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna()
        & (oi_orders["order_delivered_customer_date"] <= seed_time)
    )
    carrier_known = (
        oi_orders["order_delivered_carrier_date"].notna()
        & (oi_orders["order_delivered_carrier_date"] <= seed_time)
    )

    # Доставка до клиента (в днях), известна только для доставленных заказов
    oi_orders["delivery_days"] = np.where(
        delivered_known,
        (oi_orders["order_delivered_customer_date"]
         - oi_orders["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0,
        np.nan,
    )
    # Опоздание относительно оценки
    oi_orders["delivery_delay_days"] = np.where(
        delivered_known,
        (oi_orders["order_delivered_customer_date"]
         - oi_orders["order_estimated_delivery_date"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0,
        np.nan,
    )
    oi_orders["days_purchase_to_carrier"] = np.where(
        carrier_known,
        (oi_orders["order_delivered_carrier_date"]
         - oi_orders["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0,
        np.nan,
    )
    # Разница между оценкой и покупкой — известна сразу после покупки
    oi_orders["estimated_delivery_days"] = (
        oi_orders["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
        - oi_orders["order_purchase_timestamp"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0

    # Статус, наблюдаемый на момент seed_time
    def observed_status(row_status, delivered, carrier):
        if delivered:
            return "delivered"
        if carrier:
            return "shipped"
        return row_status if pd.notna(row_status) else "unknown"

    oi_orders["observed_status"] = [
        observed_status(s, d, c)
        for s, d, c in zip(
            oi_orders["order_status"],
            delivered_known,
            carrier_known,
        )
    ]
    oi_orders["is_delivered_known"] = delivered_known.astype(np.float64)
    oi_orders["is_canceled_or_unavailable"] = (
        oi_orders["order_status"].isin(["canceled", "unavailable"]).astype(np.float64)
    )

    # --- Отзывы: известны только те, что созданы до seed_time ---
    rev_known = reviews[
        (reviews["review_creation_date"] >= start_hist - pd.Timedelta(days=30))
        & (reviews["review_creation_date"] <= seed_time)
    ][["order_id", "review_score"]]
    rev_known = rev_known.groupby("order_id", as_index=False)["review_score"].mean()

    oi_full = oi_orders.merge(rev_known, on="order_id", how="left")

    # --- Платежи: агрегаты известны на момент покупки заказа (ts < seed_time) ---
    pay_agg = payments.groupby("order_id").agg(
        total_payment=("payment_value", "sum"),
        avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        max_installments=("payment_installments", "max"),
        n_payments=("payment_sequential", "count"),
    ).reset_index()
    oi_full = oi_full.merge(pay_agg, on="order_id", how="left")

    oi_full["credit_card"] = None
    pt = payments.merge(
        oi_hist[["order_id"]].drop_duplicates(), on="order_id", how="inner"
    )
    pt_frac = (
        pt.assign(is_cc=(pt["payment_type"] == "credit_card").astype(np.float64))
        .groupby("order_id")["is_cc"].mean()
        .rename("frac_credit_card_order")
        .reset_index()
    )
    oi_full = oi_full.merge(pt_frac, on="order_id", how="left")

    # --- Признаки активности товара в разных временных окнах ---
    ts_all = oi[["order_id", "product_id", "ts", "price", "freight_value"]]

    def window_feats(days):
        t0 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=days)
        w = ts_all[(ts_all["ts"] >= t0) & (ts_all["ts"] < seed_time)]
        g = w.groupby("product_id").agg(
            units=(("order_id"), "count"),
            revenue=("price", "sum"),
            n_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        )
        g.columns = [f"units_{days}d", f"revenue_{days}d", f"n_orders_{days}d"]
        return g

    feat_30 = window_feats(30)
    feat_90 = window_feats(90)
    feat_180 = window_feats(180)
    feat_365 = window_feats(365)

    # Активность в прошлом (до окна истории) — для давности/тренда
    before = ts_all[ts_all["ts"] < start_hist].groupby("product_id").agg(
        units_before=("price", "count"),
        last_sale_before=("ts", "max"),
    )

    agg = oi_full.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units=("order_item_id", "count"),
        total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
        total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        max_price=("price", "max"),
        min_price=("min_price",) if False else ("price", "min"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        avg_delivery_days=("delivery_days", "mean"),
        max_delivery_days=("delivery_days", "max"),
        avg_delivery_delay=("delivery_delay_days", "mean"),
        max_delivery_delay=("delivery_delay_days", "max"),
        frac_late_deliveries=(
            "delivery_delay_days",
            lambda x: (x > 0).mean() if x.notna().any() else 0.0,
        ),
        avg_purchase_to_carrier=("days_purchase_to_carrier", "mean"),
        avg_estimated_delivery_days=("estimated_delivery_days", "mean"),
        frac_delivered=("is_delivered_known", "mean"),
        frac_canceled=("is_canceled_or_unavailable", "mean"),
        frac_shipped=(
            "observed_status",
            lambda x: (x == "shipped").mean(),
        ),
        n_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        n_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
        avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        min_review_score=("review_score", "min"),
        frac_reviews=("review_score", lambda x: x.notna().mean()),
        frac_5star=("review_score", lambda x: (x == 5).mean()),
        frac_1star=("review_score", lambda x: (x == 1).mean()),
        avg_order_total=("total_payment", "mean"),
        avg_installments=("avg_installments", "mean"),
        max_installments=("max_installments", "max"),
        avg_n_payments=("n_payments", "mean"),
        avg_frac_cc=("frac_credit_card_order", "mean"),
    )
    agg["last_sale_in_hist"] = oi_full.groupby("product_id")["ts"].max()
    agg["first_sale_in_hist"] = oi_full.groupby("product_id")["ts"].min()
    agg["days_since_last_sale"] = (seed_time - agg["last_sale_in_hist"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
    agg["days_since_first_sale"] = (seed_time - agg["first_sale_in_hist"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0

    out = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"))
    out = out.join(agg, how="left")
    out = out.join(feat_30, how="left")
    out = out.join(feat_90, how="left")
    out = out.join(feat_180, how="left")
    out = out.join(feat_365, how="left")
    out = out.join(before, how="left")

    # Давность прошлой активности
    out["days_since_prehist_sale"] = (
        seed_time - out["last_sale_before"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0

    # Отзыв: отсутствие отзыва - не нейтральный балл, а отдельный признак frac_reviews
    out["avg_review_score"] = out["avg_review_score"].fillna(3.0)
    out["min_review_score"] = out["min_review_score"].fillna(3.0)
    out["frac_reviews"] = out["frac_reviews"].fillna(0.0)

    # Производные: тренд продаж
    out["trend_30_365"] = out["units_30d"] / (out["units_365d"] + 1.0)
    out["trend_90_365"] = out["units_90d"] / (out["units_365d"] + 1.0)
    out["is_new_product"] = (out["total_units"].isna()).astype(np.float64)
    out["has_history"] = out["total_units"].notna().astype(np.float64)
    out["repeat_rate"] = out["total_units"] / (out["n_orders"] + 1e-9)

    # Убираем временные столбцы
    out = out.drop(columns=["last_sale_in_hist", "first_sale_in_hist", "last_sale_before"],
                   errors="ignore")

    out = out.fillna(0.0)
    out = out.reindex(entity_ids)
    out = out.astype(np.float64)
    return out

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Unpack database tables
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]
    
    # ----------------------
    # Preprocess Payments: aggregate per order
    # ----------------------
    # Aggregate payment numerical metrics per order
    payments_agg = payments.groupby("order_id").agg(
        total_order_payment=("payment_value", "sum"),
        avg_payment_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        num_payment_sequentials=("payment_sequential", "count")
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Create payment type percentage features
    payment_type_dummies = pd.get_dummies(payments[["order_id", "payment_type"]], columns=["payment_type"])
    payment_type_dummies = payment_type_dummies.groupby("order_id").sum().reset_index()
    
    # Merge payment metrics
    payments_agg = payments_agg.merge(payment_type_dummies, on="order_id", how="left")
    # Normalize payment type counts to percentages
    payment_type_cols = [c for c in payment_type_dummies.columns if c.startswith("payment_type_")]
    for col in payment_type_cols:
        payments_agg[f"{col}_pct"] = payments_agg[col] / payments_agg["num_payment_sequentials"]
    # Drop raw count columns
    payments_agg = payments_agg.drop(columns=payment_type_cols + ["num_payment_sequentials"])
    
    # ----------------------
    # Preprocess Reviews: aggregate per order
    # ----------------------
    # Merge reviews with order timestamps to compute review delay
    reviews_with_order = reviews.merge(
        orders[["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    reviews_with_order["days_to_review_creation"] = (
        reviews_with_order["review_creation_date"] - reviews_with_order["order_purchase_timestamp"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)  # Convert to days
    
    # Aggregate review metrics per order
    reviews_agg = reviews_with_order.groupby("order_id").agg(
        avg_order_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        total_reviews_per_order=("review_id", "count"),
        pct_reviews_with_title=("review_comment_title", lambda x: x.notna().mean()),
        pct_reviews_with_message=("review_comment_message", lambda x: x.notna().mean()),
        avg_days_to_review=("days_to_review_creation", "mean")
    ).reset_index()
    
    # ----------------------
    # Create base dataset with all order-item details
    # ----------------------
    # Merge order-items with order metadata
    order_items_orders = order_items.merge(
        orders[["order_id", "customer_id", "order_status", 
                "order_purchase_timestamp", "order_delivered_carrier_date", 
                "order_delivered_customer_date", "order_estimated_delivery_date"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )
    
    # Filter to orders strictly before seed time
    order_items_orders = order_items_orders[order_items_orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time].copy()
    
    # Merge with payment and review data
    order_items_full = order_items_orders.merge(payments_agg, on="order_id", how="left")
    order_items_full = order_items_full.merge(reviews_agg, on="order_id", how="left")
    
    # ----------------------
    # Engineer derived delivery and status features
    # ----------------------
    order_items_full["days_to_carrier"] = (
        order_items_full["order_delivered_carrier_date"] - order_items_full["order_purchase_timestamp"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    order_items_full["days_carrier_to_customer"] = (
        order_items_full["order_delivered_customer_date"] - order_items_full["order_delivered_carrier_date"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    order_items_full["delivery_delay_days"] = (
        order_items_full["order_delivered_customer_date"] - order_items_full["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    
    # Binary status flags
    order_items_full["is_canceled"] = (order_items_full["order_status"] == "canceled").astype(int)
    order_items_full["is_delivered"] = (order_items_full["order_status"] == "delivered").astype(int)
    order_items_full["is_late"] = (order_items_full["delivery_delay_days"] > 0).astype(int)
    
    # ----------------------
    # Define lookback windows
    # ----------------------
    lookback_windows = [
        ("7d", pd.Timedelta(days=7)),
        ("14d", pd.Timedelta(days=14)),
        ("30d", pd.Timedelta(days=30)),
        ("90d", pd.Timedelta(days=90)),
        ("180d", pd.Timedelta(days=180)),
        ("all", None)  # All historical data before seed_time
    ]
    window_names = [win[0] for win in lookback_windows]
    
    # ----------------------
    # Initialize output with full entity list
    # ----------------------
    base_features = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)
    base_features.index.name = "product_id"
    
    # ----------------------
    # Compute features per lookback window
    # ----------------------
    for window_name, window_delta in lookback_windows:
        # Filter to current window
        if window_delta is not None:
            start_time = seed_time - window_delta
            window_data = order_items_full[
                (order_items_full["order_purchase_timestamp"] >= start_time) &
                (order_items_full["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time)
            ].copy()
        else:
            window_data = order_items_full.copy()
        
        # Skip if no data in window (will be filled later)
        if window_data.empty:
            continue
        
        # ----------------------
        # Line-item level features (per product)
        # ----------------------
        line_item_feats = window_data.groupby("product_id").agg(
            total_units=("order_item_id", "count"),
            unique_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
            unique_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
            unique_customers=("customer_id", "nunique"),
            total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
            total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
            avg_unit_price=("price", "mean"),
            avg_unit_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
            last_sale_time=("order_purchase_timestamp", "max"),
            first_sale_time=("order_purchase_timestamp", "min")
        ).reset_index()
        
        # Time-based features
        line_item_feats["days_since_last_sale"] = (
            seed_time - line_item_feats["last_sale_time"]
        ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
        line_item_feats["product_age_days"] = (
            seed_time - line_item_feats["first_sale_time"]
        ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
        line_item_feats = line_item_feats.drop(columns=["last_sale_time", "first_sale_time"])
        
        # ----------------------
        # Order-level features (per product, unique orders)
        # ----------------------
        unique_product_orders = window_data[
            ["product_id", "order_id", "is_canceled", "is_delivered", "is_late",
             "days_to_carrier", "days_carrier_to_customer", "delivery_delay_days",
             "total_order_payment", "avg_payment_installments",
             "payment_type_credit_card_pct", "payment_type_boleto_pct",
             "payment_type_voucher_pct", "payment_type_debit_card_pct",
             "avg_order_review_score", "total_reviews_per_order",
             "pct_reviews_with_title", "pct_reviews_with_message", "avg_days_to_review"]
        ].drop_duplicates(subset=["product_id", "order_id"])
        
        order_level_feats = unique_product_orders.groupby("product_id").agg(
            pct_canceled_orders=("is_canceled", "mean"),
            pct_delivered_orders=("is_delivered", "mean"),
            pct_late_deliveries=("is_late", "mean"),
            avg_days_to_carrier=("days_to_carrier", "mean"),
            avg_days_carrier_to_customer=("days_carrier_to_customer", "mean"),
            avg_delivery_delay=("delivery_delay_days", "mean"),
            avg_total_order_payment=("total_order_payment", "mean"),
            avg_payment_installments=("avg_payment_installments", "mean"),
            avg_pct_credit_card=("payment_type_credit_card_pct", "mean"),
            avg_pct_boleto=("payment_type_boleto_pct", "mean"),
            avg_pct_voucher=("payment_type_voucher_pct", "mean"),
            avg_pct_debit_card=("payment_type_debit_card_pct", "mean"),
            avg_review_score=("avg_order_review_score", "mean"),
            total_reviews=("total_reviews_per_order", "sum"),
            avg_pct_reviews_with_titles=("pct_reviews_with_title", "mean"),
            avg_pct_reviews_with_messages=("pct_reviews_with_message", "mean"),
            avg_days_to_review=("avg_days_to_review", "mean")
        ).reset_index()
        
        # ----------------------
        # Merge window features
        # ----------------------
        window_features = line_item_feats.merge(order_level_feats, on="product_id", how="outer")
        # Rename columns with window suffix
        rename_map = {col: f"{col}_{window_name}" for col in window_features.columns if col!= "product_id"}
        window_features = window_features.rename(columns=rename_map)
        window_features = window_features.set_index("product_id")
        
        # Join to base features
        base_features = base_features.join(window_features, how="left")
    
    # ----------------------
    # Create indicator features for data availability
    # ----------------------
    for win in window_names:
        sales_col = f"total_units_{win}"
        review_col = f"total_reviews_{win}"
        base_features[f"has_sales_{win}"] = (base_features[sales_col] > 0).astype(int) if sales_col in base_features.columns else 0
        base_features[f"has_reviews_{win}"] = (base_features[review_col] > 0).astype(int) if review_col in base_features.columns else 0
    
    # ----------------------
    # Handle missing values
    # ----------------------
    # Indicator columns: fill NaNs with 0
    indicator_cols = [c for c in base_features.columns if c.startswith("has_")]
    base_features[indicator_cols] = base_features[indicator_cols].fillna(0).astype(int)
    
    # Count/sum columns: fill NaNs with 0
    count_sum_keys = ["total_units", "unique_orders", "unique_sellers", "unique_customers", 
                      "total_revenue", "total_freight", "total_reviews"]
    count_sum_cols = [c for c in base_features.columns if any(k in c for k in count_sum_keys)]
    base_features[count_sum_cols] = base_features[count_sum_cols].fillna(0)
    
    # Days since last sale: fill with large value (1e5 days = ~273 years)
    days_since_cols = [c for c in base_features.columns if "days_since_last_sale" in c]
    base_features[days_since_cols] = base_features[days_since_cols].fillna(1e5)
    
    # Product age: fill with 0 (no prior sales)
    age_cols = [c for c in base_features.columns if "product_age_days" in c]
    base_features[age_cols] = base_features[age_cols].fillna(0)
    
    # All remaining columns: fill with 0
    remaining_cols = [c for c in base_features.columns 
                      if c not in count_sum_cols + days_since_cols + age_cols + indicator_cols]
    base_features[remaining_cols] = base_features[remaining_cols].fillna(0)
    
    # ----------------------
    # Finalize output to match required entity list
    # ----------------------
    base_features = base_features.reindex(entity_ids)
    base_features.index.name = "product_id"
    
    return base_features

        & (orders_hist["order_delivered_carrier_date"] < seed_time)
    )

    orders_hist.loc[~carrier_before, "order_delivered_carrier_date"] = pd.NaT
    orders_hist.loc[~delivered_before, "order_delivered_customer_date"] = pd.NaT

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)

    lookback_90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    lookback_180 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)
    lookback_365 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=365)

    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]

    # Только покупки, совершённые до seed_time (момент известен в seed_time)
    orders_hist = orders[orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] <= seed_time]

    relevant_items = order_items[order_items["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)]
    items_full = relevant_items.merge(
        orders_hist[["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp", "order_status"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="inner",
    )
    items_historic = items_full[items_full["order_purchase_timestamp"] <= seed_time]

    def agg_window(items, suffix):
        if len(items) == 0:
            return pd.DataFrame({"product_id": []})
        return items.groupby("product_id").agg(
            units_sold=("order_item_id", "count"),
            revenue=("price", "sum"),
            avg_price=("price", "mean"),
            total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
            unique_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
            unique_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
        ).rename(columns=lambda c: f"{c}_{suffix}").reset_index()

    items_7 = items_historic[items_historic["order_purchase_timestamp"] > seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=7)]
    items_30 = items_historic[items_historic["order_purchase_timestamp"] > seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)]
    items_90 = items_historic[items_historic["order_purchase_timestamp"] > lookback_90]
    items_180 = items_historic[items_historic["order_purchase_timestamp"] > lookback_180]
    items_365 = items_historic[items_historic["order_purchase_timestamp"] > lookback_365]

    agg_7 = agg_window(items_7, "7")
    agg_30 = agg_window(items_30, "30")
    agg_90 = agg_window(items_90, "90")
    agg_180 = agg_window(items_180, "180")
    agg_365 = agg_window(items_365, "365")

    # Recency
    if len(items_historic):
        last_purchase = items_historic.groupby("product_id")["order_purchase_timestamp"].max()
        first_purchase = items_historic.groupby("product_id")["order_purchase_timestamp"].min()
        recency = pd.DataFrame({
            "recency_days": (seed_time - last_purchase).dt.days,
            "age_days": (seed_time - first_purchase).dt.days,
        }).reset_index()
    else:
        recency = pd.DataFrame(columns=["product_id", "recency_days", "age_days"])

    # Тренд: продажи в последних 90 днях vs предыдущие 90 дней
    prev_90 = items_historic[
        (items_historic["order_purchase_timestamp"] > lookback_180) &
        (items_historic["order_purchase_timestamp"] <= lookback_90)
    ]
    units_prev_90 = prev_90.groupby("product_id")["order_item_id"].count().rename("units_prev_90").reset_index()

    # Отзывы: учитываем только отзывы, уже опубликованные к seed_time
    reviews_known = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] <= seed_time]
    items_reviews = items_historic.merge(
        reviews_known[["order_id", "review_score"]], on="order_id", how="left"
    )
    review_agg = items_reviews.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_review=("review_score", "mean"),
        total_reviews=("review_score", "count"),
        neg_reviews=("review_score", lambda s: (s <= 2).sum()),
    ).reset_index()
    if len(review_agg):
        review_agg["neg_share"] = review_agg["neg_reviews"] / review_agg["total_reviews"].replace(0, np.nan)
    else:
        review_agg["neg_share"] = pd.Series(dtype=float)

    # Статусы заказов (известно на seed_time)
    delivered_mask = items_historic["order_status"] == "delivered"
    status_agg = items_historic.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_items_status=("order_item_id", "count"),
        delivered_items=("order_status", lambda s: (s == "delivered").sum()),
        canceled_items=("order_status", lambda s: (s == "canceled").sum()),
    ).reset_index()
    if len(status_agg):
        status_agg["canceled_share"] = status_agg["canceled_items"] / status_agg["total_items_status"].replace(0, np.nan)
    else:
        status_agg["canceled_share"] = pd.Series(dtype=float)

    final_features = pd.DataFrame({"product_id": entity_ids})
    for df in [agg_7, agg_30, agg_90, agg_180, agg_365, recency, units_prev_90, review_agg, status_agg]:
        final_features = final_features.merge(df, on="product_id", how="left")

    final_features = final_features.set_index("product_id")

    # Производные признаки
    if "units_90" in final_features.columns:
        final_features["trend_90"] = final_features["units_90"] - final_features["units_prev_90"].fillna(0)
        final_features["ratio_90_prev90"] = final_features["units_90"] / (final_features["units_prev_90"].fillna(0) + 1)
    if "units_180" in final_features.columns:
        final_features["units_90_share_180"] = final_features["units_90"] / (final_features["units_180"] + 1)

    fill_zero_cols = [c for c in final_features.columns
                      if c not in ("recency_days", "age_days", "avg_review", "avg_price_7",
                                   "avg_price_30", "avg_price_90", "avg_price_180",
                                   "avg_price_365", "neg_share", "canceled_share")]
    final_features[fill_zero_cols] = final_features[fill_zero_cols].fillna(0)

    for c in ["avg_review", "neg_share", "canceled_share",
              "avg_price_7", "avg_price_30", "avg_price_90",
              "avg_price_180", "avg_price_365"]:
        if c in final_features.columns:
            final_features[c] = final_features[c].fillna(0)

    final_features["recency_days"] = final_features["recency_days"].fillna(9999)
    final_features["age_days"] = final_features["age_days"].fillna(9999)

    final_features = final_features.reindex(entity_ids)
    final_features = final_features.astype(float)

    return final_features

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Extract tables from the database
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]
    
    # Filter order items to only those before seed_time (historical data)
    oi_hist = order_items[order_items["ts"] < seed_time].copy()
    
    # Merge order items with orders to get customer and order status info
    oi_orders = pd.merge(
        oi_hist,
        orders[["order_id", "customer_id", "order_status"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    ).dropna(subset=["order_id", "customer_id"])  # Drop invalid rows (should be none)
    
    # Define time windows relative to seed_time
    win_30 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    win_90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    win_180 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)
    
    # ------------------------------
    # ALL-TIME HISTORICAL FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    prod_all = oi_orders.groupby("product_id").agg(
        # Count metrics
        total_units=("order_id", "count"),
        total_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_customers=("customer_id", "nunique"),
        # Price metrics
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        median_price=("price", "median"),
        max_price=("price", "max"),
        min_price=("price", "min"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
        # Freight metrics
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        # Time metrics
        last_purchase_ts=("ts", "max"),
        first_purchase_ts=("ts", "min"),
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Compute time-since features
    prod_all["days_since_last_purchase"] = (seed_time - prod_all["last_purchase_ts"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    prod_all["days_since_first_purchase"] = (seed_time - prod_all["first_purchase_ts"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    prod_all["avg_units_per_order"] = prod_all["total_units"] / prod_all["total_orders"].replace(0, np.nan)
    
    # ------------------------------
    # WINDOWED HISTORICAL FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    # Last 30 days
    oi_30 = oi_orders[oi_orders["ts"] >= win_30].copy()
    prod_30 = oi_30.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units_30d=("order_id", "count"),
        total_orders_30d=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_revenue_30d=("price", "sum"),
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Last 90 days
    oi_90 = oi_orders[oi_orders["ts"] >= win_90].copy()
    prod_90 = oi_90.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units_90d=("order_id", "count"),
        total_orders_90d=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_customers_90d=("customer_id", "nunique"),
        total_revenue_90d=("price", "sum"),
        avg_price_90d=("price", "mean"),
        last_purchase_90d=("ts", "max"),
    ).reset_index()
    prod_90["days_since_last_purchase_90d"] = (seed_time - prod_90["last_purchase_90d"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    
    # Last 180 days
    oi_180 = oi_orders[oi_orders["ts"] >= win_180].copy()
    prod_180 = oi_180.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units_180d=("order_id", "count"),
        total_orders_180d=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_revenue_180d=("price", "sum"),
    ).reset_index()
    
    # ------------------------------
    # ORDER STATUS FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    order_status = oi_orders.groupby(["product_id", "order_status"]).agg(
        status_count=("order_id", "nunique")
    ).reset_index()
    order_status_pivot = order_status.pivot(
        index="product_id",
        columns="order_status",
        values="status_count"
    ).fillna(0).reset_index()
    order_status_pivot.columns = [
        f"order_status_{col.lower().replace(' ', '_')}" if col != "product_id" else col
        for col in order_status_pivot.columns
    ]
    
    # ------------------------------
    # REVIEW FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    oi_reviews = pd.merge(
        oi_orders[["product_id", "order_id"]],
        reviews[["order_id", "review_score", "review_comment_title", "review_comment_message"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    oi_reviews["has_comment"] = (
        oi_reviews["review_comment_title"].notna() | oi_reviews["review_comment_message"].notna()
    ).astype(int)
    review_features = oi_reviews.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_reviews=("review_score", "count"),
        avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        min_review_score=("review_score", "min"),
        max_review_score=("review_score", "max"),
        std_review_score=("review_score", "std"),
        frac_reviews_with_comment=("has_comment", "mean"),
    ).reset_index()
    
    # ------------------------------
    # PAYMENT FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    oi_payments = pd.merge(
        oi_orders[["product_id", "order_id"]],
        payments[["order_id", "payment_type", "payment_installments", "payment_value"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    # Aggregated payment features
    payment_features = oi_payments.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_payment_value=("payment_value", "sum"),
        avg_payment_value_per_item=("payment_value", "mean"),
        avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        max_installments=("payment_installments", "max"),
        num_unique_payment_types=("payment_type", "nunique"),
    ).reset_index()
    # Payment type dummy features
    oi_payments = pd.concat([
        oi_payments,
        pd.get_dummies(oi_payments["payment_type"], prefix="pay_type")
    ], axis=1)
    payment_type_features = oi_payments.groupby("product_id").agg(
        **{f"pay_{col}_count": (col, "sum") for col in oi_payments.columns if col.startswith("pay_type_")},
        **{f"pay_{col}_frac": (col, "mean") for col in oi_payments.columns if col.startswith("pay_type_")},
    ).reset_index()
    
    # ------------------------------
    # MERGE ALL FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    all_features = prod_all.copy()
    all_features = pd.merge(all_features, prod_30, on="product_id", how="outer")
    all_features = pd.merge(all_features, prod_90, on="product_id", how="outer")
    all_features = pd.merge(all_features, prod_180, on="product_id", how="outer")
    all_features = pd.merge(all_features, order_status_pivot, on="product_id", how="outer")
    all_features = pd.merge(all_features, review_features, on="product_id", how="outer")
    all_features = pd.merge(all_features, payment_features, on="product_id", how="outer")
    all_features = pd.merge(all_features, payment_type_features, on="product_id", how="outer")
    
    # ------------------------------
    # CREATE ADDITIONAL DERIVED FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    # Binary flag for any sales history
    all_features["has_any_sales"] = (~all_features["total_units"].isna()).astype(int)
    
    # Growth ratio features
    all_features["ratio_30d_to_90d_units"] = all_features["total_units_30d"] / all_features["total_units_90d"].replace(0, np.nan)
    all_features["ratio_90d_to_180d_units"] = all_features["total_units_90d"] / all_features["total_units_180d"].replace(0, np.nan)
    all_features["ratio_30d_to_all_units"] = all_features["total_units_30d"] / all_features["total_units"].replace(0, np.nan)
    all_features["ratio_90d_to_all_units"] = all_features["total_units_90d"] / all_features["total_units"].replace(0, np.nan)
    
    # Average order interval
    all_features["avg_days_between_orders"] = np.where(
        all_features["total_orders"] > 1,
        (all_features["days_since_first_purchase"] - all_features["days_since_last_purchase"]) / (all_features["total_orders"] - 1),
        0
    )
    
    # ------------------------------
    # CLEAN AND REINDEX TO INPUT ENTITIES
    # ------------------------------
    # Drop non-numeric datetime columns
    datetime_cols = ["last_purchase_ts", "first_purchase_ts", "last_purchase_90d"]
    all_features = all_features.drop(columns=[col for col in datetime_cols if col in all_features.columns], errors="ignore")
    
    # Set product_id as index and reindex to input entity_ids
    all_features = all_features.set_index("product_id")
    final_features = all_features.reindex(entity_ids)
    
    # Identify feature groups for consistent NaN filling
    count_cols = [col for col in final_features.columns if (
        col.startswith("total_") or col.startswith("num_") or 
        (col.startswith("pay_") and col.endswith("_count")) or
        col.startswith("order_status_")
    )]
    avg_cols = [col for col in final_features.columns if (
        col.startswith("avg_") or col.startswith("median_") or
        col.startswith("max_") or col.startswith("min_") or
        col.startswith("std_") or col.endswith("_frac")
    )]
    time_cols = [
        "days_since_last_purchase", "days_since_first_purchase",
        "days_since_last_purchase_90d"
    ]
    ratio_cols = [col for col in final_features.columns if col.startswith("ratio_")]
    
    # Fill NaNs for all feature groups
    final_features["has_any_sales"] = final_features["has_any_sales"].fillna(0)
    final_features[count_cols] = final_features[count_cols].fillna(0)
    final_features[avg_cols] = final_features[avg_cols].fillna(0)
    final_features[time_cols] = final_features[time_cols].fillna(10000)  # Arbitrary large value for "never purchased"
    final_features[ratio_cols] = final_features[ratio_cols].fillna(0)
    final_features["avg_units_per_order"] = final_features["avg_units_per_order"].fillna(0)
    final_features["avg_days_between_orders"] = final_features["avg_days_between_orders"].fillna(0)
    
    # Final cleanup of any remaining invalid values
    final_features = final_features.fillna(0)
    final_features = final_features.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0)
    
    return final_features

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    # ---- Only information available strictly before seed_time ----

    # Order items: ts is the purchase moment of the order
    oi_hist = order_items[order_items["ts"] < seed_time].copy()

    if len(oi_hist) == 0:
        final = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"))
        final["has_any_sales"] = 0
        final["total_units"] = 0
        return final.fillna(0)

    # Orders: keep only orders purchased before seed_time.
    # Note: order_status may be updated AFTER seed_time (e.g. delivered later),
    # so we do NOT use order_status as a feature to avoid leakage.
    orders_hist = orders[orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time]

    oi_orders = pd.merge(
        oi_hist,
        orders_hist[["order_id", "customer_id"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )

    win_30 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    win_90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    win_180 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)

    # ------------------------------
    # ALL-TIME HISTORICAL FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    prod_all = oi_orders.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units=("order_id", "count"),
        total_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_customers=("customer_id", "nunique"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        median_price=("price", "median"),
        max_price=("price", "max"),
        min_price=("price", "min"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        last_purchase_ts=("ts", "max"),
        first_purchase_ts=("ts", "min"),
    ).reset_index()

    prod_all["days_since_last_purchase"] = (seed_time - prod_all["last_purchase_ts"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    prod_all["days_since_first_purchase"] = (seed_time - prod_all["first_purchase_ts"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    prod_all["avg_units_per_order"] = prod_all["total_units"] / prod_all["total_orders"].replace(0, np.nan)

    # ------------------------------
    # WINDOWED HISTORICAL FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    oi_30 = oi_orders[oi_orders["ts"] >= win_30]
    prod_30 = oi_30.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units_30d=("order_id", "count"),
        total_orders_30d=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_revenue_30d=("price", "sum"),
    ).reset_index()

    oi_90 = oi_orders[oi_orders["ts"] >= win_90]
    prod_90 = oi_90.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units_90d=("order_id", "count"),
        total_orders_90d=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_customers_90d=("customer_id", "nunique"),
        total_revenue_90d=("price", "sum"),
        avg_price_90d=("price", "mean"),
        last_purchase_90d=("ts", "max"),
    ).reset_index()
    prod_90["days_since_last_purchase_90d"] = (seed_time - prod_90["last_purchase_90d"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)

    oi_180 = oi_orders[oi_orders["ts"] >= win_180]
    prod_180 = oi_180.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units_180d=("order_id", "count"),
        total_orders_180d=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_revenue_180d=("price", "sum"),
    ).reset_index()

    # ------------------------------
    # TREND FEATURES (weekly units over last 90 days)
    # ------------------------------
    trend = oi_90.copy()
    trend["week"] = ((seed_time - trend["ts"]).dt.days // 7)
    trend_agg = trend.groupby(["product_id", "week"]).agg(
        units=("order_id", "count")
    ).reset_index()
    # weeks 0-2 (recent) vs weeks 10-12 (older, within 90d)
    recent = trend_agg[trend_agg["week"] < 3].groupby("product_id")["units"].sum().rename("units_recent_3w")
    older = trend_agg[(trend_agg["week"] >= 10) & (trend_agg["week"] <= 12)].groupby("product_id")["units"].sum().rename("units_older_3w")
    trend_df = pd.concat([recent, older], axis=1).reset_index()
    trend_df["units_recent_3w"] = trend_df["units_recent_3w"].fillna(0)
    trend_df["units_older_3w"] = trend_df["units_older_3w"].fillna(0)

    # ------------------------------
    # REVIEW FEATURES (reviews written before seed_time only)
    # ------------------------------
    reviews_hist = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time]
    oi_reviews = pd.merge(
        oi_orders[["product_id", "order_id", "ts"]],
        reviews_hist[["order_id", "review_score", "review_comment_title", "review_comment_message"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )
    if len(oi_reviews) > 0:
        oi_reviews["has_comment"] = (
            oi_reviews["review_comment_title"].notna() | oi_reviews["review_comment_message"].notna()
        ).astype(int)
        review_features = oi_reviews.groupby("product_id").agg(
            total_reviews=("review_score", "count"),
            avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
            min_review_score=("review_score", "min"),
            max_review_score=("review_score", "max"),
            std_review_score=("review_score", "std"),
            frac_reviews_with_comment=("has_comment", "mean"),
        ).reset_index()
    else:
        review_features = pd.DataFrame(columns=["product_id"])

    # ------------------------------
    # PAYMENT FEATURES (payments known before seed_time only)
    # ------------------------------
    payments_hist = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time]
    oi_payments = pd.merge(
        oi_orders[["product_id", "order_id"]],
        payments_hist[["order_id", "payment_type", "payment_installments", "payment_value"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )
    if len(oi_payments) > 0:
        payment_features = oi_payments.groupby("product_id").agg(
            total_payment_value=("payment_value", "sum"),
            avg_payment_value_per_item=("payment_value", "mean"),
            avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
            max_installments=("payment_installments", "max"),
            num_unique_payment_types=("payment_type", "nunique"),
        ).reset_index()
        dummies = pd.get_dummies(oi_payments["payment_type"], prefix="pay_type").astype(float)
        oi_pay_d = pd.concat([oi_payments[["product_id"]], dummies], axis=1)
        pay_agg = oi_pay_d.groupby("product_id").sum()
        payment_type_features = pay_agg.reset_index()
    else:
        payment_features = pd.DataFrame(columns=["product_id"])
        payment_type_features = pd.DataFrame(columns=["product_id"])

    # ------------------------------
    # MERGE ALL FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    all_features = prod_all.copy()
    for part in (prod_30, prod_90, prod_180, trend_df, review_features,
                 payment_features, payment_type_features):
        if len(part) > 0:
            all_features = pd.merge(all_features, part, on="product_id", how="left")

    # ------------------------------
    # DERIVED FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    all_features["has_any_sales"] = (~all_features["total_units"].isna()).astype(int)
    all_features["ratio_30d_to_90d_units"] = all_features["total_units_30d"] / all_features["total_units_90d"].replace(0, np.nan)
    all_features["ratio_90d_to_180d_units"] = all_features["total_units_90d"] / all_features["total_units_180d"].replace(0, np.nan)
    all_features["ratio_30d_to_all_units"] = all_features["total_units_30d"] / all_features["total_units"].replace(0, np.nan)
    all_features["ratio_90d_to_all_units"] = all_features["total_units_90d"] / all_features["total_units"].replace(0, np.nan)
    all_features["avg_days_between_orders"] = np.where(
        all_features["total_orders"] > 1,
        (all_features["days_since_first_purchase"] - all_features["days_since_last_purchase"]) / (all_features["total_orders"] - 1),
        0
    )
    all_features["recent_vs_older_units"] = all_features["units_recent_3w"] / all_features["units_older_3w"].replace(0, np.nan)

    # ------------------------------
    # CLEAN AND REINDEX
    # ------------------------------
    datetime_cols = ["last_purchase_ts", "first_purchase_ts", "last_purchase_90d"]
    all_features = all_features.drop(columns=[c for c in datetime_cols if c in all_features.columns], errors="ignore")
    # ensure numeric
    for c in all_features.columns:
        if c != "product_id":
            all_features[c] = pd.to_numeric(all_features[c], errors="coerce")

    all_features = all_features.set_index("product_id")
    final_features = all_features.reindex(entity_ids)

    count_cols = [c for c in final_features.columns if (
        c.startswith("total_") or c.startswith("num_") or c.startswith("units_") or
        (c.startswith("pay_type_"))
    )]
    other_cols = [c for c in final_features.columns if c not in count_cols and c != "has_any_sales"]

    final_features["has_any_sales"] = final_features["has_any_sales"].fillna(0)
    if count_cols:
        final_features[count_cols] = final_features[count_cols].fillna(0)
    if other_cols:
        final_features[other_cols] = final_features[other_cols].fillna(0)
    final_features = final_features.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0)
    final_features = final_features.fillna(0)

    return final_features

def get_features(db, entity_ids, seed_time):
    """
    Вычисляет признаки для каждого product_id на основе данных до seed_time.
    Возвращает DataFrame с индексами entity_ids (в исходном порядке).
    """
    # Распаковка баз данных
    orders = db['orders']
    items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    # Отбираем продажи целевых товаров, произошедшие не позднее seed_time
    items_use = items[items['product_id'].isin(entity_ids) & (items['ts'] <= seed_time)]

    # --- Агрегация по товарам, если есть история продаж ---
    if not items_use.empty:
        # Основные агрегированные метрики по каждой позиции товара
        agg = items_use.groupby('product_id').agg(
            sales_count=('order_id', 'count'),
            unique_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
            unique_sellers=('seller_id', 'nunique'),
            total_price=('price', 'sum'),
            avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
            std_price=('price', 'std'),
            min_price=('price', 'min'),
            max_price=('price', 'max'),
            total_freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
            avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
            last_sale_ts=('ts', 'max')
        ).reset_index()

        # Продажи за последние 7 / 30 / 90 дней
        for period, suffix in [(7, '7d'), (30, '30d'), (90, '90d')]:
            mask = items_use['ts'] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=period)
            tmp = items_use[mask].groupby('product_id').agg(
                cnt=('order_id', 'count'),
                rev=('price', 'sum')
            ).reset_index()
            tmp.columns = ['product_id', f'sales_{suffix}', f'revenue_{suffix}']
            agg = agg.merge(tmp, on='product_id', how='left')

        # Отзывы на заказы, содержащие товар (по review_score)
        rev = items_use[['order_id', 'product_id']].merge(
            reviews[['order_id', 'review_score']],
            on='order_id',
            how='left'
        )
        rev = rev.dropna(subset=['review_score'])
        if not rev.empty:
            rev_agg = rev.groupby('product_id').agg(
                avg_review_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
                review_count=('review_score', 'count')
            ).reset_index()
        else:
            rev_agg = pd.DataFrame(columns=['product_id', 'avg_review_score', 'review_count'])

        agg = agg.merge(rev_agg, on='product_id', how='left')

    else:
        # Если история пуста – создаём пустой агрегат с нужными столбцами
        cols = ['product_id'] + [
            'sales_count', 'unique_orders', 'unique_sellers',
            'total_price', 'avg_price', 'std_price', 'min_price', 'max_price',
            'total_freight', 'avg_freight', 'sales_7d', 'revenue_7d',
            'sales_30d', 'revenue_30d', 'sales_90d', 'revenue_90d',
            'avg_review_score', 'review_count'
        ]
        agg = pd.DataFrame(columns=cols)

    # --- Сборка результирующего DataFrame ---
    # базовая таблица со всеми product_id
    res = pd.DataFrame({'product_id': entity_ids})

    # присоединяем агрегированные признаки
    if not agg.empty:
        res = res.merge(agg, on='product_id', how='left')

    # --- Признак "дней с последней продажи" ---
    if 'last_sale_ts' in res.columns:
        res['days_since_last_sale'] = (seed_time - res['last_sale_ts']).dt.days
        res['days_since_last_sale'] = res['days_since_last_sale'].fillna(999.0).astype(float)
        res = res.drop(columns=['last_sale_ts'])
    else:
        res['days_since_last_sale'] = 999.0

    # --- Заполнение пропусков числовых признаков нулями ---
    num_cols = [
        'sales_count', 'unique_orders', 'unique_sellers',
        'total_price', 'avg_price', 'std_price', 'min_price', 'max_price',
        'total_freight', 'avg_freight',
        'sales_7d', 'revenue_7d', 'sales_30d', 'revenue_30d',
        'sales_90d', 'revenue_90d',
        'avg_review_score', 'review_count'
    ]
    for col in num_cols:
        if col not in res.columns:
            res[col] = 0.0
        else:
            res[col] = res[col].fillna(0.0).astype(float)

    # Переиндексируем по entity_ids
    res = res.set_index('product_id')
    res = res.reindex(entity_ids)

    return res

def get_features(db, entity_ids, seed_time):
    """
    Вычисляет признаки для каждого product_id, используя только информацию,
    доступную на момент seed_time:
      - позиции заказа учитываются по ts (момент покупки) <= seed_time;
      - отзывы учитываются только по review_creation_date <= seed_time
        (отзыв появляется позже покупки);
      - даты доставки/одобрения не используются как "факт" для заказов,
        которые на seed_time ещё не могли быть доставлены.
    """
    orders = db['orders']
    items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)

    # Продажи целевых товаров, произошедшие не позднее seed_time
    items_use = items[items['product_id'].isin(entity_ids) & (items['ts'] <= seed_time)]

    cols = ['product_id'] + [
        'sales_count', 'unique_orders', 'unique_sellers',
        'total_price', 'avg_price', 'std_price', 'min_price', 'max_price',
        'total_freight', 'avg_freight',
        'sales_7d', 'revenue_7d', 'sales_30d', 'revenue_30d',
        'sales_90d', 'revenue_90d',
        'avg_review_score', 'review_count', 'neg_review_share',
        'days_since_last_sale', 'days_since_first_sale',
        'sales_trend_30d_vs_prev30d', 'delivery_delay_days', 'delivered_share'
    ]

    if not items_use.empty:
        agg = items_use.groupby('product_id').agg(
            sales_count=('order_id', 'count'),
            unique_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
            unique_sellers=('seller_id', 'nunique'),
            total_price=('price', 'sum'),
            avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
            std_price=('price', 'std'),
            min_price=('price', 'min'),
            max_price=('price', 'max'),
            total_freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
            avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
            last_sale_ts=('ts', 'max'),
            first_sale_ts=('ts', 'min')
        ).reset_index()

        # Скользящие окна продаж
        for period, suffix in [(7, '7d'), (30, '30d'), (90, '90d')]:
            mask = items_use['ts'] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=period)
            tmp = items_use[mask].groupby('product_id').agg(
                cnt=('order_id', 'count'),
                rev=('price', 'sum')
            ).reset_index()
            tmp.columns = ['product_id', f'sales_{suffix}', f'revenue_{suffix}']
            agg = agg.merge(tmp, on='product_id', how='left')

        # Тренд: продажи за последние 30 дней против предыдущих 30 дней
        cur_mask = items_use['ts'] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
        prev_mask = (items_use['ts'] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=60)) & (~cur_mask)
        cur = items_use[cur_mask].groupby('product_id')['order_id'].count().rename('cur30')
        prev = items_use[prev_mask].groupby('product_id')['order_id'].count().rename('prev30')
        agg = agg.merge(cur.reset_index(), on='product_id', how='left')
        agg = agg.merge(prev.reset_index(), on='product_id', how='left')
        agg['sales_trend_30d_vs_prev30d'] = (
            agg['cur30'].fillna(0.0) - agg['prev30'].fillna(0.0)
        ) / (agg['prev30'].fillna(0.0) + 1.0)
        agg = agg.drop(columns=['cur30', 'prev30'])

        # Отзывы: учитываем только те, что уже написаны к seed_time
        rev = items_use[['order_id', 'product_id']].merge(
            reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] <= seed_time][['order_id', 'review_score']],
            on='order_id',
            how='inner'
        )
        if not rev.empty:
            rev_agg = rev.groupby('product_id').agg(
                avg_review_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
                review_count=('review_score', 'count'),
                neg_review_share=('review_score', lambda s: (s <= 2).mean())
            ).reset_index()
        else:
            rev_agg = pd.DataFrame(columns=['product_id', 'avg_review_score',
                                            'review_count', 'neg_review_share'])
        agg = agg.merge(rev_agg, on='product_id', how='left')

        # Доставка: только для заказов, которые на seed_time уже могли быть доставлены,
        # т.е. доставлены ДО seed_time
        ord_cols = ['order_id', 'order_delivered_customer_date',
                    'order_purchase_timestamp', 'order_estimated_delivery_date']
        delivered = orders[orders['order_delivered_customer_date'] <= seed_time][ord_cols]
        it_del = items_use[['order_id', 'product_id']].drop_duplicates('order_id').merge(
            delivered, on='order_id', how='inner'
        )
        if not it_del.empty:
            it_del = it_del.dropna(subset=['order_delivered_customer_date'])
            it_del['delivery_delay_days'] = (
                (it_del['order_delivered_customer_date'] - it_del['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
            )
            del_agg = it_del.groupby('product_id').agg(
                delivery_delay_days=('delivery_delay_days', 'mean')
            ).reset_index()
            n_del = it_del.groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique().rename('n_delivered').reset_index()
            agg = agg.merge(del_agg, on='product_id', how='left')
            agg = agg.merge(n_del, on='product_id', how='left')
            agg['delivered_share'] = agg['n_delivered'] / agg['unique_orders'].replace(0, np.nan)
            agg = agg.drop(columns=['n_delivered'])
        else:
            agg['delivery_delay_days'] = np.nan
            agg['delivered_share'] = np.nan

        # Временные признаки
        agg['days_since_last_sale'] = (seed_time - agg['last_sale_ts']).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
        agg['days_since_first_sale'] = (seed_time - agg['first_sale_ts']).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
        agg = agg.drop(columns=['last_sale_ts', 'first_sale_ts'])
    else:
        agg = pd.DataFrame(columns=cols)

    # Сборка результата
    res = pd.DataFrame({'product_id': entity_ids})
    if not agg.empty:
        res = res.merge(agg, on='product_id', how='left')

    num_cols = [c for c in cols if c != 'product_id']
    for col in num_cols:
        if col not in res.columns:
            res[col] = 0.0
        else:
            res[col] = pd.to_numeric(res[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0.0).astype(float)

    res = res.set_index('product_id')
    res = res.reindex(entity_ids)
    return res

def get_features(db, entity_ids, seed_time):
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    if not isinstance(seed_time, pd.Timestamp):
        seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)

    features = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Filter order_items by purchase time (<= seed_time)
    oi = db["order_items"].copy()
    oi = oi[oi["ts"] <= seed_time]

    if len(oi) == 0:
        # No history for any product → return all zero features
        return features

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Merge reviews (only the score)
    reviews = db["reviews"][["order_id", "review_score"]]
    oi = oi.merge(reviews, on="order_id", how="left")

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. Add time windows
    oi["days_diff"] = (seed_time - oi["ts"]).dt.days
    oi["last_7"]   = (oi["days_diff"] <= 7)   & (oi["days_diff"] >= 0)
    oi["last_30"]  = (oi["days_diff"] <= 30)  & (oi["days_diff"] >= 0)
    oi["last_60"]  = (oi["days_diff"] <= 60)  & (oi["days_diff"] >= 0)
    oi["last_90"]  = (oi["days_diff"] <= 90)  & (oi["days_diff"] >= 0)

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. Item-level aggregation (per product)
    item_agg = oi.groupby("product_id").agg(
        n_orders        = ("order_id", "nunique"),
        n_items         = ("price", "count"),
        total_price     = ("price", "sum"),
        avg_price       = ("price", "mean"),
        median_price    = ("price", "median"),
        std_price       = ("price", "std"),
        total_freight   = ("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_freight     = ("freight_value", "mean"),
        std_freight     = ("freight_value", "std"),
        n_sellers       = ("seller_id", "nunique"),
        avg_review      = ("review_score", "mean"),
        n_reviews       = ("review_score", "count"),
        cnt_last_7      = ("last_7", "sum"),
        cnt_last_30     = ("last_30", "sum"),
        cnt_last_60     = ("last_60", "sum"),
        cnt_last_90     = ("last_90", "sum"),
        last_order_ts   = ("ts", "max"),
        first_order_ts  = ("ts", "min"),
    ).reset_index()

    # Recency features
    item_agg["days_since_last"] = (seed_time - item_agg["last_order_ts"]).dt.days
    item_agg["days_since_first"] = (seed_time - item_agg["first_order_ts"]).dt.days
    item_agg.drop(columns=["last_order_ts", "first_order_ts"], inplace=True)

    # Average items per order (only where n_orders > 0) – replace inf with 0
    item_agg["avg_items_per_order"] = item_agg["n_items"] / item_agg["n_orders"].replace(0, np.nan)
    item_agg["avg_items_per_order"] = item_agg["avg_items_per_order"].fillna(0)

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. Order-level payment features
    # Unique (order, product) pairs for correct payment aggregation
    order_prod = oi[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates()
    payments = db["payments"]
    pay_by_order = payments.groupby("order_id")["payment_value"].sum().reset_index().rename(
        columns={"payment_value": "order_total_payment"}
    )
    order_prod = order_prod.merge(pay_by_order, on="order_id", how="left")

    pay_agg = order_prod.groupby("product_id").agg(
        n_orders_with_payment = ("order_total_payment", "count"),
        sum_order_payment     = ("order_total_payment", "sum"),
        avg_payment_per_order = ("order_total_payment", "mean"),
    ).reset_index()

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 6. Merge & reindex
    features = item_agg.merge(pay_agg, on="product_id", how="left")
    features.set_index("product_id", inplace=True)

    # Reindex to entity_ids and fill missing/NaN
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids, fill_value=0)
    features = features.fillna(0)

    return features

    item_agg[["share_last_30", "share_last_90"]] = item_agg[["share_last_30", "share_last_90"]].fillna(0)

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 6. Payment features per product (only past payments)
    order_prod = oi[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates()
    order_prod = order_prod.merge(pay_by_order, on="order_id", how="left")

    pay_agg = order_prod.groupby("product_id").agg(
        n_orders_with_payment = ("order_total_payment", "count"),
        sum_order_payment     = ("order_total_payment", "sum"),
        avg_payment_per_order = ("order_total_payment", "mean"),
    ).reset_index()

    # 7. Merge & reindex
    features = item_agg.merge(pay_agg, on="product_id", how="left")
    features.set_index("product_id", inplace=True)
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids)
    features = features.fillna(0)

    items = items.merge(ord_cols, on='order_id', how='left')

    st = items['order_purchase_timestamp']

    items['is_canceled'] = ((items['order_status'] == 'canceled') &
                            (st < seed_time)).astype(float)

        mean_est_delivery_lag=('est_delivery_lag_days', 'mean'),
        mean_actual_delivery_lag=('actual_delivery_lag_days', 'mean'),
        delivered_late_rate=('delivered_late', 'mean')
    ).reset_index()

    # 5. Оконные признаки за последние 14, 30, 60, 90, 180, 365 дней

        sub = items[items['ts'] > seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=N)]
        g = sub.groupby('product_id')
        ord_cnt = g['order_id'].nunique()
        rev_sum = g['price'].sum()
        cust_cnt = g['customer_id'].nunique()
        mean_price = g['price'].mean()
        idx = base['product_id']
        base[f'orders_{N}d'] = ord_cnt.reindex(idx, fill_value=0).values
        base[f'revenue_{N}d'] = rev_sum.reindex(idx, fill_value=0).values
        base[f'customers_{N}d'] = cust_cnt.reindex(idx, fill_value=0).values
        base[f'mean_price_{N}d'] = mean_price.reindex(idx).values

    first_ts = items.groupby('product_id')['ts'].min()
    last_ts = items.groupby('product_id')['ts'].max()

    )

        "total_orders", "total_unique_orders", "total_price", "total_freight",

        "reviews_count", "avg_review_score", "positive_review_ratio",
        "total_payment_value", "avg_payment_installments", "n_payment_records",
        "ever_sold"
    ]

    # Если нет ни одного заказа для данных товаров – возвращаем нулевую матрицу
    if merged.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame(
            0,
            index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"),
            columns=cols_names
        )

    # Вычисляем количество дней до seed_time
    merged["days_before"] = (seed_time - merged["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.days

    # --- Общие агрегаты ---
    agg = merged.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_orders=("order_id", "size"),
        total_unique_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_price=("price", "sum"),
        total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        max_price=("price", "max")
    ).reset_index()
    agg["std_price"] = agg["std_price"].fillna(0)
    agg["ever_sold"] = 1

    # --- Агрегаты за различные окна ---
    for period, suffix in [(30, "30"), (90, "90"), (180, "180")]:
        period_df = merged[merged["days_before"] <= period].groupby("product_id").agg(
            total_orders=("order_id", "size"),
            total_price=("price", "sum")
        ).reset_index()
        period_df = period_df.rename(columns={
            "total_orders": f"total_orders_{suffix}",
            "total_price": f"total_price_{suffix}"
        })

    ).reset_index()
    agg = agg.merge(pay_prod_agg, on="product_id", how="left")

    # --- Реиндексация и заполнение пропусков ---
    agg = agg.set_index("product_id").reindex(entity_ids)
    agg = agg.fillna(0)

    # Бинарный признак наличия продаж (для товаров без истории = 0)
    agg["ever_sold"] = (agg["total_orders"] > 0).astype(int)

    agg = agg[cols_names]
