def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db['orders']
    order_items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)
    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)

    # --- Товары: продажи строго до seed_time ---
    work = order_items[(order_items['product_id'].isin(entity_ids))
                       & (order_items['ts'] < seed_time)].copy()

    # --- Заказы, "видимые" на seed_time: покупка до seed_time ---
    visible_orders = orders[orders['order_purchase_timestamp'] < seed_time]
    # доступная на момент seed_time информация о статусе/доставке:
    # даты доставки учитываем только если они <= seed_time (иначе ещё не известно)
    visible_orders = visible_orders.copy()
    for col in ['order_approved_at', 'order_delivered_carrier_date',
                'order_delivered_customer_date', 'order_estimated_delivery_date']:
        visible_orders.loc[visible_orders[col] > seed_time, col] = pd.NaT

    # --- Отзывы: только те, что уже созданы к seed_time ---
    visible_reviews = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] < seed_time][
        ['order_id', 'review_score']].drop_duplicates(subset='order_id')

    # --- Платежи: только по видимым заказам ---
    visible_payments = payments[payments['order_id'].isin(visible_orders['order_id'])]

    result = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name='product_id'))

    empty = len(work) == 0

    # ---------- Признаки за всё время ----------
    if not empty:
        total_grp = work.groupby('product_id').agg(
            orders_total=('order_id', 'nunique'),
            units_total=('order_item_id', 'count'),
            price_total=('price', 'sum'),
            freight_total=('freight_value', 'sum'),
            price_avg=('price', 'mean'),
            freight_avg=('freight_value', 'mean'),
            first_sale=('ts', 'min'),
            last_sale=('ts', 'max'),
        )
        total_grp['age_days'] = (seed_time - total_grp['first_sale']).dt.days
        total_grp['days_since_last'] = (seed_time - total_grp['last_sale']).dt.days
        total_grp['sales_span_days'] = (total_grp['last_sale'] - total_grp['first_sale']).dt.days
        total_grp['orders_per_month'] = total_grp['orders_total'] / ((total_grp['age_days'] / 30.0).clip(lower=1))
        total_grp = total_grp.drop(columns=['first_sale', 'last_sale'])

        # отзывы (только видимые на seed_time)
        wr = work.merge(visible_reviews, on='order_id', how='left')
        rev_grp = wr.groupby('product_id').agg(
            review_avg=('review_score', 'mean'),
            review_cnt=('review_score', 'count'),
        )

        # платежи (только видимые заказы)
        wp = work.merge(visible_payments[['order_id', 'payment_value', 'payment_installments']],
                        on='order_id', how='left')
        pay_grp = wp.groupby('product_id').agg(
            pay_total=('payment_value', 'sum'),
            pay_installments_avg=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
        )

        feat = total_grp.join(rev_grp, how='left').join(pay_grp, how='left')
        for col in feat.columns:
            result[col] = feat[col].reindex(entity_ids)
    else:
        for col in ['orders_total', 'units_total', 'price_total', 'freight_total',
                    'price_avg', 'freight_avg', 'age_days', 'days_since_last',
                    'sales_span_days', 'orders_per_month',
                    'review_avg', 'review_cnt', 'pay_total', 'pay_installments_avg']:
            result[col] = np.nan

    # ---------- Временные окна ----------
    windows = [7, 30, 90, 180, 365]
    for w in windows:
        cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=w)
        ww = work[work['ts'] >= cutoff]
        if len(ww) > 0:
            grp = ww.groupby('product_id').agg(
                orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
                items=('order_item_id', 'count'),
                price=('price', 'sum'),
                freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
            )
            grp.columns = [f'{c}_{w}d' for c in grp.columns]
            for col in grp.columns:
                result[col] = grp[col].reindex(entity_ids)
        else:
            for c in ['orders', 'items', 'price', 'freight']:
                result[f'{c}_{w}d'] = np.nan

        # тренд: продажи в окне w относительно предыдущего окна такой же длины
        prev_start = cutoff - pd.Timedelta(days=w)
        wp = work[(work['ts'] >= prev_start) & (work['ts'] < cutoff)]
        if len(wp) > 0:
            prev_grp = wp.groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
            result[f'orders_prev_{w}d'] = prev_grp.reindex(entity_ids)
        else:
            result[f'orders_prev_{w}d'] = np.nan
        cur = result.get(f'orders_{w}d')
        prev = result[f'orders_prev_{w}d']
        with np.errstate(divide='ignore', invalid='ignore'):
            ratio = (cur - prev) / (prev + 1.0)
        result[f'orders_trend_{w}d'] = ratio.fillna(0.0)

    # ---------- Отзывы за последние 90 дней ----------
    cutoff_90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    w90 = work[work['ts'] >= cutoff_90]
    if len(w90) > 0:
        wr90 = w90.merge(visible_reviews, on='order_id', how='left')
        g = wr90.groupby('product_id').agg(
            review_avg_90d=('review_score', 'mean'),
            review_cnt_90d=('review_score', 'count'),
        )
        for col in g.columns:
            result[col] = g[col].reindex(entity_ids)
    else:
        result['review_avg_90d'] = np.nan
        result['review_cnt_90d'] = np.nan

    # ---------- Доставочные признаки (только доставленное к seed_time) ----------
    deliv = visible_orders[['order_id', 'order_delivered_customer_date',
                            'order_estimated_delivery_date']].dropna(
        subset=['order_delivered_customer_date'])
    if len(deliv) > 0 and not empty:
        wd = work.merge(deliv, on='order_id', how='inner')
        if len(wd) > 0:
            wd['delay_days'] = (wd['order_delivered_customer_date'] -
                                wd['order_estimated_delivery_date']).dt.days
            g = wd.groupby('product_id').agg(
                delivery_delay_avg=('delay_days', 'mean'),
                delivered_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
            )
            for col in g.columns:
                result[col] = g[col].reindex(entity_ids)
        else:
            result['delivery_delay_avg'] = np.nan
            result['delivered_orders'] = np.nan
    else:
        result['delivery_delay_avg'] = np.nan
        result['delivered_orders'] = np.nan

    # ---------- Финальная очистка ----------
    result = result.reindex(entity_ids)
    result = result.astype(float).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    return result

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Извлечение таблиц
    orders = db['orders']
    items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']  # пока не используем, но оставлено для расширения

    # Фильтруем позиции товаров по entity_ids
    items = items[items['product_id'].isin(entity_ids)]

    # Объединяем с заказами, чтобы получить дату покупки и даты доставки
    merged = items.merge(
        orders[['order_id', 'order_purchase_timestamp', 'order_delivered_customer_date', 'order_estimated_delivery_date']],
        on='order_id',
        how='left'
    )

    # Оставляем только события строго до seed_time
    merged = merged[merged['order_purchase_timestamp'] < seed_time]

    # Создаём пустой каркас для результата
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)

    # Если после фильтрации нет данных — вернуть нулевые признаки
    if merged.empty:
        features['total_orders'] = 0.0
        features['total_items'] = 0.0
        features['total_sales'] = 0.0
        features['avg_price'] = 0.0
        features['avg_freight'] = 0.0
        features['avg_total_value'] = 0.0
        features['avg_delivery_days'] = 0.0
        features['delayed_count'] = 0.0
        features['avg_review_score'] = 0.0
        features['count_reviews'] = 0.0
        features['neg_review_count'] = 0.0
        return features

    # Производные колонки
    merged['total_value'] = merged['price'] + merged['freight_value']
    merged['delivery_days'] = (
        merged['order_delivered_customer_date'] - merged['order_purchase_timestamp']
    ).dt.days
    merged['is_delayed'] = (
        merged['order_delivered_customer_date'] > merged['order_estimated_delivery_date']
    ).astype(int)

    # Основные агрегации по товару (без учёта отзывов)
    agg = merged.groupby('product_id').agg(
        total_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
        total_items=('order_id', 'count'),
        total_sales=('price', 'sum'),
        avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
        avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
        avg_total_value=('total_value', 'mean'),
        avg_delivery_days=('delivery_days', 'mean'),
        delayed_count=('is_delayed', 'sum'),
    ).reset_index()

    # Устанавливаем индекс product_id для будущего соединения
    agg.set_index('product_id', inplace=True)

    # --- Признаки из отзывов (рейтингов) ---
    # Берём только id заказов и их рейтинг
    reviews_sel = reviews[['order_id', 'review_score']]

    # Сопоставляем с текущими товарами (только заказы до seed_time)
    rev_merge = merged[['product_id', 'order_id']].merge(reviews_sel, on='order_id', how='left')
    rev_merge = rev_merge.dropna(subset=['review_score'])

    if rev_merge.empty:
        # Нет ни одного отзыва к товарам
        agg['avg_review_score'] = 0.0
        agg['count_reviews'] = 0.0
        agg['neg_review_count'] = 0.0
    else:
        rev_agg = rev_merge.groupby('product_id').agg(
            avg_review_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
            count_reviews=('review_score', 'count'),
            neg_review_count=('review_score', lambda x: (x <= 1).sum())
        )
        agg = agg.join(rev_agg, how='left')

    # Объединяем результат с каркасом и заполняем пропуски нулями
    features = features.join(agg, how='left')
    features = features.fillna(0.0)

    return features

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db['orders']
    items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)
    items = items[items['product_id'].isin(entity_ids)]
    items = items[items['ts'] < seed_time]

    merged = items.merge(
        orders[['order_id', 'order_purchase_timestamp', 'order_approved_at',
                'order_delivered_carrier_date', 'order_delivered_customer_date',
                'order_estimated_delivery_date', 'order_status']],
        on='order_id', how='left'
    )
    merged = merged[merged['order_purchase_timestamp'] < seed_time]

    # Доставка известна только если доставка произошла до seed_time
    delivered_mask = merged['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna() & \
                     (merged['order_delivered_customer_date'] < seed_time)

    merged['delivery_days'] = np.where(
        delivered_mask,
        (merged['order_delivered_customer_date'] - merged['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.days,
        np.nan
    )
    merged['is_delayed'] = np.where(
        delivered_mask,
        (merged['order_delivered_customer_date'] > merged['order_estimated_delivery_date']).astype(float),
        np.nan
    )
    merged['delivered'] = delivered_mask.astype(float)
    merged['approval_hours'] = np.where(
        merged['order_approved_at'].notna() & (merged['order_approved_at'] < seed_time),
        (merged['order_approved_at'] - merged['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.total_seconds() / 3600.0,
        np.nan
    )
    merged['total_value'] = merged['price'] + merged['freight_value']

    base = merged[['product_id', 'order_id', 'price', 'freight_value', 'total_value',
                   'delivery_days', 'is_delayed', 'delivered', 'approval_hours',
                   'order_purchase_timestamp']]

    # Отзывы: берём только те, что уже созданы до seed_time
    reviews_known = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] < seed_time][['order_id', 'review_score']]
    rev_merge = base[['product_id', 'order_id']].merge(reviews_known, on='order_id', how='inner')
    rev_merge = rev_merge.dropna(subset=['review_score'])

    # Платежи: только известные до seed_time
    pay_known = payments[payments['ts'] < seed_time][['order_id', 'payment_value', 'payment_installments']]
    pay_merge = base[['product_id', 'order_id']].merge(
        pay_known.groupby('order_id', as_index=False).agg(
            payment_value=('payment_value', 'sum'),
            payment_installments=('payment_installments', 'max')),
        on='order_id', how='inner'
    )

    now = seed_time

    def product_agg(df, suffix):
        if df.empty:
            return pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index([], name='product_id'))
        g = df.groupby('product_id')
        out = pd.DataFrame({
            f'total_orders_{suffix}': g['order_id'].nunique(),
            f'total_items_{suffix}': g['order_id'].count(),
            f'total_sales_{suffix}': g['price'].sum(),
            f'avg_price_{suffix}': g['price'].mean(),
            f'avg_freight_{suffix}': g['freight_value'].mean(),
            f'avg_total_value_{suffix}': g['total_value'].mean(),
            f'avg_delivery_days_{suffix}': g['delivery_days'].mean(),
            f'delayed_rate_{suffix}': g['is_delayed'].mean(),
            f'delivered_rate_{suffix}': g['delivered'].mean(),
            f'avg_approval_hours_{suffix}': g['approval_hours'].mean(),
            f'last_purchase_days_{suffix}': g['order_purchase_timestamp'].max().rsub(now).dt.days,
            f'first_purchase_days_{suffix}': g['order_purchase_timestamp'].min().rsub(now).dt.days,
        })
        return out

    all_time = product_agg(base, 'all')

    hist = base[base['order_purchase_timestamp'] >= now - pd.Timedelta(days=90)]
    win90 = product_agg(hist, '90d')

    hist30 = base[base['order_purchase_timestamp'] >= now - pd.Timedelta(days=30)]
    win30 = product_agg(hist30, '30d')

    agg = all_time.join(win90, how='outer').join(win30, how='outer')

    if not rev_merge.empty:
        rg = rev_merge.groupby('product_id')['review_score']
        agg['avg_review_score'] = rg.mean()
        agg['count_reviews'] = rg.count()
        agg['neg_review_rate'] = rg.apply(lambda x: (x <= 2).mean())
        agg['low_review_rate'] = rg.apply(lambda x: (x <= 1).mean())
        recent_rev = rev_merge[rev_merge['order_id'].isin(
            base.loc[base['order_purchase_timestamp'] >= now - pd.Timedelta(days=90), 'order_id'])]
        if not recent_rev.empty:
            agg['avg_review_score_90d'] = recent_rev.groupby('product_id')['review_score'].mean()
    else:
        agg['avg_review_score'] = np.nan
        agg['count_reviews'] = np.nan
        agg['neg_review_rate'] = np.nan
        agg['low_review_rate'] = np.nan
        agg['avg_review_score_90d'] = np.nan

    if not pay_merge.empty:
        pg = pay_merge.groupby('product_id').agg(
            avg_payment=('payment_value', 'mean'),
            max_installments=('payment_installments', 'max'),
            pay_count=('order_id', 'nunique'),
        )
        agg = agg.join(pg, how='left')
    else:
        agg['avg_payment'] = np.nan
        agg['max_installments'] = np.nan
        agg['pay_count'] = np.nan

    features = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name='product_id'))
    features = features.join(agg, how='left')

    # Флаг активности товара
    features['is_active'] = features['total_orders_all'].notna().astype(float)
    features = features.fillna(0.0)

    # Мгновенные признаки
    features['recency_ratio'] = np.where(
        features['total_orders_all'] > 0,
        features['total_orders_90d'] / features['total_orders_all'],
        0.0
    )
    features['neg_review_rate'] = features['neg_review_rate'].clip(0, 1)

    return features.reindex(entity_ids)

def get_features(db, entity_ids, seed_time):
    # Извлекаем таблицы
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    orders = db["orders"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]  # может пригодиться, но здесь не используем

    entities = list(entity_ids)

    # Отбираем только прошлые продажи (до seed_time)
    items_past = order_items[
        (order_items["product_id"].isin(entities)) &
        (order_items["ts"] <= seed_time)
    ]

    # Строим feature-датафрейм с индексом = entity_ids
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=entities)

    # 1. Агрегаты за всю предшествующую историю
    if not items_past.empty:
        agg_all = items_past.groupby("product_id").agg(
            n_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
            n_items=("order_item_id", "count"),
            total_price=("price", "sum"),
            total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
            mean_price=("price", "mean"),
            mean_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
            std_price=("price", "std"),
            std_freight=("freight_value", "std"),
            n_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
            min_ts=("ts", "min"),
            max_ts=("ts", "max")
        )
        features = features.join(agg_all)
    else:
        # Пустой датафрейм – всё останется NaN
        pass

    # 2. Признаки, связанные со временем
    if "max_ts" in features.columns:
        features["days_since_last"] = (seed_time - features["max_ts"]).dt.days
        features["days_since_first"] = (seed_time - features["min_ts"]).dt.days
        features["active_days"] = (features["max_ts"] - features["min_ts"]).dt.days

    # 3. Агрегаты по временным окнам (30, 60, 90, 180 дней)
    windows = [30, 60, 90, 180]
    for win in windows:
        cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=win)
        items_win = items_past[items_past["ts"] > cutoff]  # строго последние win дней
        if items_win.empty:
            # Заполняем нулями (нет продаж в окне)
            features[f"cnt_orders_{win}"] = 0
            features[f"cnt_items_{win}"] = 0
            features[f"sum_price_{win}"] = 0.0
            features[f"has_sales_{win}"] = 0
        else:
            agg_win = items_win.groupby("product_id").agg(
                cnt_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
                cnt_items=("order_item_id", "count"),
                sum_price=("price", "sum"),
                mean_price=("price", "mean")
            ).add_prefix(f"win{win}_")
            features = features.join(agg_win)

    # 4. Признаки на основе отзывов
    if not items_past.empty and not reviews.empty:
        # Средняя оценка по каждому заказу (может быть несколько отзывов на заказ)
        order_rating = reviews.groupby("order_id")["review_score"].mean().rename("avg_review").reset_index()

        # Связываем заказы и товары
        prod_orders = items_past[["product_id", "order_id"]].drop_duplicates()
        prod_orders = prod_orders.merge(order_rating, on="order_id", how="left")

        if prod_orders["avg_review"].notna().any():
            rating_agg = prod_orders.groupby("product_id")["avg_review"].agg(
                ["mean", "count", lambda x: (x >= 4).mean() * 100]  # процент положительных отзывов
            ).rename(columns={"mean": "avg_review_score",
                              "count": "n_reviews",
                              "<lambda_0>": "pct_positive_reviews"})
            features = features.join(rating_agg)

    # 5. Дополнительные признаки: число платежей, доля способов оплаты и т.д.
    # Это можно добавить, но для простоты пропустим.

    # 6. Глобальные временные признаки
    features["month"] = seed_time.month
    features["quarter"] = seed_time.quarter
    features["day_of_week"] = seed_time.dayofweek
    features["year"] = seed_time.year

    # 7. Признак "есть ли вообще продажи" – полезен, чтобы отличить 0 из-за малого периода
    if "n_orders" in features.columns:
        features["has_sales"] = (features["n_orders"].fillna(0) > 0).astype(int)
    else:
        features["has_sales"] = 0

    # 8. Заполняем оставшиеся пропуски нулями
    features = features.fillna(0.0)

    # 9. Переиндексируем в порядок входных entity_ids (они уже в features.index)
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids, fill_value=0.0)
    features.index.name = "product_id"

    return features

    # 1. Агрегаты за всю предшествующую историю
    if not items_past.empty:
        agg_all = items_past.groupby("product_id").agg(
            n_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
            n_items=("order_item_id", "count"),
            total_price=("price", "sum"),
            total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
            mean_price=("price", "mean"),
            mean_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
            std_price=("price", "std"),
            std_freight=("freight_value", "std"),
            n_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
            min_ts=("ts", "min"),
            max_ts=("ts", "max")
        )
        features = features.join(agg_all)

    # 2. Временные признаки
    if "max_ts" in features.columns:
        features["days_since_last"] = (seed_time - features["max_ts"]).dt.days
        features["days_since_first"] = (seed_time - features["min_ts"]).dt.days
        features["active_days"] = (features["max_ts"] - features["min_ts"]).dt.days
        features = features.drop(columns=["min_ts", "max_ts"])

    # 3. Окна 30/60/90/180 дней
    for win in [30, 60, 90, 180]:
        cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=win)
        items_win = items_past[items_past["ts"] > cutoff]
        if items_win.empty:
            features[f"win{win}_cnt_orders"] = 0
            features[f"win{win}_cnt_items"] = 0
            features[f"win{win}_sum_price"] = 0.0
            features[f"win{win}_mean_price"] = 0.0
        else:
            agg_win = items_win.groupby("product_id").agg(
                cnt_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
                cnt_items=("order_item_id", "count"),
                sum_price=("price", "sum"),
                mean_price=("price", "mean")
            ).add_prefix(f"win{win}_")
            features = features.join(agg_win)

    # 4. Признаки на основе отзывов — только отзывы, УЖЕ созданные к seed_time
    if not items_past.empty and not reviews.empty:
        rev_past = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] <= seed_time]
        if not rev_past.empty:
            order_rating = rev_past.groupby("order_id")["review_score"].mean().rename("avg_review").reset_index()
            prod_orders = items_past[["product_id", "order_id"]].drop_duplicates()
            prod_orders = prod_orders.merge(order_rating, on="order_id", how="inner")
            if not prod_orders.empty:
                rating_agg = prod_orders.groupby("product_id")["avg_review"].agg(
                    avg_review_score="mean",
                    n_reviews="count",
                    pct_positive_reviews=lambda x: (x >= 4).mean() * 100
                )
                features = features.join(rating_agg)

    # 5. Платежи (только по заказам, произошедшим до seed_time)
    if not items_past.empty and not payments.empty:
        pay_past = payments[payments["ts"] <= seed_time]
        if not pay_past.empty:
            prod_orders = items_past[["product_id", "order_id"]].drop_duplicates()
            po = prod_orders.merge(
                pay_past.groupby("order_id").agg(
                    pay_value=("payment_value", "sum"),
                    pay_installments=("payment_installments", "mean")
                ), on="order_id", how="inner")
            if not po.empty:
                pay_agg = po.groupby("product_id").agg(
                    pay_value_mean=("pay_value", "mean"),
                    pay_installments_mean=("pay_installments", "mean"))
                features = features.join(pay_agg)

    # 6. Глобальные календарные признаки
    features["month"] = seed_time.month
    features["quarter"] = seed_time.quarter
    features["day_of_week"] = seed_time.dayofweek
    features["year"] = seed_time.year

    # 7. Флаг наличия продаж
    features["has_sales"] = (features["n_orders"].fillna(0) > 0).astype(int)

    features = features.fillna(0.0)
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids, fill_value=0.0)
    features = features.astype(float)
    features.index.name = "product_id"

    return features

    # Реиндексируем по entity_ids и заполняем пропуски нулями
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def get_features(db, entity_ids, seed_time):
    if not isinstance(seed_time, pd.Timestamp):
        seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)

    items = db['order_items']
    orders = db['orders']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    # --- Товары: только позиции, купленные до seed_time ---
    items = items[items['ts'] <= seed_time].copy()
    items['days_since_purchase'] = (seed_time - items['ts']).dt.days

    # --- Заказы: только заказы, купленные до seed_time ---
    ord_cols = ['order_id', 'order_purchase_timestamp', 'order_status',
                'order_delivered_customer_date', 'order_estimated_delivery_date']
    ord_f = orders[orders['order_purchase_timestamp'] <= seed_time][ord_cols].copy()

    df = items.merge(ord_f, on='order_id', how='inner')

    # --- Доставка: учитываем только если она реально произошла до seed_time ---
    delivered_known = (df['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna()) & \
                      (df['order_delivered_customer_date'] <= seed_time)
    df['delivery_days'] = np.where(
        delivered_known,
        (df['order_delivered_customer_date'] - df['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.days,
        np.nan
    )
    df['is_delivered'] = delivered_known.astype(float)
    df['late'] = np.where(
        delivered_known & (df['order_delivered_customer_date'] > df['order_estimated_delivery_date']),
        1.0, 0.0
    )

    # --- Окна активности ---
    df['last_7'] = (df['days_since_purchase'] <= 7).astype(int)
    df['last_30'] = (df['days_since_purchase'] <= 30).astype(int)
    df['last_90'] = (df['days_since_purchase'] <= 90).astype(int)
    df['last_180'] = (df['days_since_purchase'] <= 180).astype(int)
    df['prev_90'] = ((df['days_since_purchase'] > 90) & (df['days_since_purchase'] <= 180)).astype(int)

    # --- Базовые агрегаты по товару ---
    grouped = df.groupby('product_id').agg(
        num_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
        num_items=('order_id', 'size'),
        total_price=('price', 'sum'),
        avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
        median_price=('price', 'median'),
        std_price=('price', 'std'),
        max_price=('price', 'max'),
        min_price=('price', 'min'),
        total_freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
        avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
        freight_ratio=('freight_value', lambda s: s.sum() / max(s.sum() + df.loc[s.index, 'price'].sum(), 1e-9)),
        avg_delivery_days=('delivery_days', 'mean'),
        min_delivery_days=('delivery_days', 'min'),
        max_delivery_days=('delivery_days', 'max'),
        std_delivery_days=('delivery_days', 'std'),
        late_delivery_rate=('late', 'mean'),
        delivered_rate=('is_delivered', 'mean'),
        days_since_last_order=('days_since_purchase', 'min'),
        days_since_first_order=('days_since_purchase', 'max'),
        last_7_orders=('last_7', 'sum'),
        last_30_orders=('last_30', 'sum'),
        last_90_orders=('last_90', 'sum'),
        last_180_orders=('last_180', 'sum'),
        prev_90_orders=('prev_90', 'sum'),
    ).reset_index()

    grouped['order_frequency'] = grouped['num_orders'] / (grouped['days_since_first_order'] + 1)
    grouped['freq_last_90'] = grouped['last_90_orders'] / 90.0
    grouped['freq_last_30'] = grouped['last_30_orders'] / 30.0
    grouped['trend_30_vs_90'] = grouped['last_30_orders'] / 30.0 - grouped['last_90_orders'] / 90.0
    grouped['trend_90_vs_prev90'] = grouped['last_90_orders'] - grouped['prev_90_orders']
    grouped['acceleration'] = grouped['last_30_orders'] - grouped['prev_90_orders'] / 3.0
    grouped['share_recent'] = grouped['last_90_orders'] / (grouped['num_orders'] + 1e-9)

    # --- Отзывы: только те, что уже созданы к seed_time ---
    rev = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] <= seed_time][['order_id', 'review_score']].copy()
    rev_agg = rev.groupby('order_id').agg(avg_review_score=('review_score', 'mean')).reset_index()

    df_r = df[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates().merge(rev_agg, on='order_id', how='inner')
    review_prod = df_r.groupby('product_id').agg(
        avg_review_score=('avg_review_score', 'mean'),
        min_review_score=('avg_review_score', 'min'),
        std_review_score=('avg_review_score', 'std'),
        num_reviewed_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
        bad_review_rate=('avg_review_score', lambda s: (s <= 2).mean()),
    ).reset_index()
    review_prod['review_coverage'] = review_prod['num_reviewed_orders'] / (grouped.set_index('product_id').loc[review_prod['product_id'], 'num_orders'].values + 1e-9)

    # --- Платежи: только проведённые до seed_time ---
    pay = payments[payments['ts'] <= seed_time].copy()
    pay_agg = pay.groupby('order_id').agg(
        total_payment=('payment_value', 'sum'),
        num_payments=('payment_sequential', 'count'),
        max_installments=('payment_installments', 'max'),
        has_voucher=('payment_type', lambda s: float((s == 'voucher').any())),
    ).reset_index()

    df_p = df[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates().merge(pay_agg, on='order_id', how='inner')
    pay_prod = df_p.groupby('product_id').agg(
        avg_payment_value=('total_payment', 'mean'),
        avg_num_payments=('num_payments', 'mean'),
        avg_installments=('max_installments', 'mean'),
        voucher_rate=('has_voucher', 'mean'),
    ).reset_index()

    features = grouped.merge(review_prod, on='product_id', how='left')
    features = features.merge(pay_prod, on='product_id', how='left')

    features.set_index('product_id', inplace=True)
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids)

    num_cols = features.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns
    for c in features.columns:
        if c not in num_cols:
            features[c] = features[c].astype(float)
    features = features.fillna(0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0)

    return features

    items["is_delivered"] = (items["order_status"] == "delivered").astype(int)

    # Главная группировка по товару
    g = items.groupby("product_id")
    feat = g.agg(
        order_count=("order_id", "count"),

        unique_customers=("customer_id", "nunique"),

        total_reviews=("rev_count", "sum"),

        max_ts=("ts", "max"),
        min_ts=("ts", "min"),
    )

    # Временные признаки: давность последней и первой покупки
    last_purchase_days = (seed_time - feat["max_ts"]) / pd.Timedelta(days=1)
    first_purchase_days = (seed_time - feat["min_ts"]) / pd.Timedelta(days=1)

    feat["last_purchase_days"] = last_purchase_days
    feat["first_purchase_days"] = first_purchase_days
    feat["avg_daily_orders"] = feat["order_count"] / first_purchase_days.clip(lower=1)

    # Убираем временные вспомогательные колонки
    feat = feat.drop(columns=["max_ts", "min_ts"])

    # Связываем с запрошенными id (для отсутствующих товаров — значения по умолчанию)
    result = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)
    result = result.join(feat, how="left")
    result = result.fillna(0.0)

    # Убеждаемся, что индексы в том же порядке, как просили
    result = result.reindex(entity_ids)
    return result

            "avg_installments", "avg_payment_value", "credit_share", "debit_share",
            "voucher_share", "paid_over_price",
            "last_purchase_days", "first_purchase_days", "avg_daily_orders",
            "median_interarrival", "trend_90_180",
        ]
        for c in cols:
            result[c] = 0.0
        return result.reindex(entity_ids)

    items["cnt_30"] = (items["ts"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)).astype(int)
    items["cnt_60"] = (items["ts"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=60)).astype(int)
    items["cnt_90"] = (items["ts"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)).astype(int)
    items["cnt_180"] = (items["ts"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)).astype(int)
    items["cnt_365"] = (items["ts"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=365)).astype(int)

    g = items.groupby("product_id")
    feat = g.agg(
        order_count=("order_id", "count"),
        unique_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        unique_customers=("customer_id", "nunique"),
        unique_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
        total_price=("price", "sum"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        max_price=("price", "max"),
        min_price=("price", "min"),
        total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        cnt_30=("cnt_30", "sum"),
        cnt_60=("cnt_60", "sum"),
        cnt_90=("cnt_90", "sum"),
        cnt_180=("cnt_180", "sum"),
        cnt_365=("cnt_365", "sum"),
        delivered_share=("is_delivered", "mean"),
        shipped_share=("is_shipped", "mean"),
        approved_share=("is_approved", "mean"),
        avg_review=("rev_avg", "mean"),
        std_review=("rev_std", "mean"),
        total_reviews=("rev_count", "sum"),
        rev_min=("rev_min", "mean"),
        rev_max=("rev_max", "mean"),
        avg_installments=("install_mean", "mean"),
        avg_payment_value=("total_pay", "mean"),
        credit_share=("credit_share", "mean"),
        debit_share=("debit_share", "mean"),
        voucher_share=("voucher_share", "mean"),
        paid_over_price=("total_pay", "mean"),
        max_ts=("ts", "max"),
        min_ts=("ts", "min"),
    )

    feat["review_rate"] = feat["total_reviews"] / feat["unique_orders"].clip(lower=1)
    feat["freight_ratio"] = feat["total_freight"] / feat["total_price"].clip(lower=0.01)

    # Средний интервал между покупками товара
    def _interarrival(s):
        t = np.sort(s.values)
        if len(t) < 2:
            return np.nan
        return np.median(np.diff(t).astype("timedelta64[D]").astype(float))

    feat["median_interarrival"] = g["ts"].apply(_interarrival)

    # Тренд: активность последних 90 дней против предыдущих 90
    feat["trend_90_180"] = (feat["cnt_90"] - (feat["cnt_180"] - feat["cnt_90"])) / feat["unique_orders"].clip(lower=1)

    last_purchase_days = (seed_time - feat["max_ts"]) / pd.Timedelta(days=1)
    first_purchase_days = (seed_time - feat["min_ts"]) / pd.Timedelta(days=1)
    feat["last_purchase_days"] = last_purchase_days
    feat["first_purchase_days"] = first_purchase_days
    feat["avg_daily_orders"] = feat["order_count"] / first_purchase_days.clip(lower=1)

    feat = feat.drop(columns=["max_ts", "min_ts"])

    feat = feat.fillna(0.0)

    result = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids))
    result = result.join(feat, how="left")
    result = result.fillna(0.0)
    result = result.reindex(entity_ids)
    return result

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Ensure entity_ids is a list for consistent indexing
    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)
    
    # Step 1: Identify valid orders placed BEFORE seed_time to avoid data leakage
    valid_orders = db["orders"][
        db["orders"]["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time
    ]["order_id"].unique()
    
    # --------------------------
    # 1. Aggregate Order Items Features (core product sales metrics)
    # --------------------------
    filtered_order_items = db["order_items"][
        (db["order_items"]["order_id"].isin(valid_orders)) &
        (db["order_items"]["ts"] < seed_time)
    ].copy()
    
    # Base sales aggregations
    sales_agg = filtered_order_items.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_items=("order_item_id", "count"),
        total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        unique_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
        first_sale_ts=("ts", "min"),
        last_sale_ts=("ts", "max")
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Recency features (relative to seed_time)
    sales_agg["days_since_first_sale"] = (seed_time - sales_agg["first_sale_ts"]).dt.days
    sales_agg["days_since_last_sale"] = (seed_time - sales_agg["last_sale_ts"]).dt.days
    sales_agg = sales_agg.drop(columns=["first_sale_ts", "last_sale_ts"])  # Drop non-numeric datetime columns
    
    # Time-windowed sales trends (30/60/90 days before seed_time)
    windows = {
        "orders_30d": seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30),
        "orders_60d": seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=60),
        "orders_90d": seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    }
    for col_name, cutoff in windows.items():
        window_sales = filtered_order_items[
            filtered_order_items["ts"] >= cutoff
        ].groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique().rename(col_name)
        sales_agg = sales_agg.merge(window_sales, on="product_id", how="left")
        sales_agg[col_name] = sales_agg[col_name].fillna(0)
    
    # Ratios to capture recent activity momentum
    sales_agg["ratio_30_to_90"] = sales_agg["orders_30d"] / (sales_agg["orders_90d"] + 1e-9)
    sales_agg["ratio_60_to_90"] = sales_agg["orders_60d"] / (sales_agg["orders_90d"] + 1e-9)
    
    # --------------------------
    # 2. Aggregate Review Features
    # --------------------------
    filtered_reviews = db["reviews"][db["reviews"]["order_id"].isin(valid_orders)].copy()
    # Link reviews to products via order_items
    review_product = filtered_reviews.merge(
        filtered_order_items[["order_id", "product_id"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    
    review_agg = review_product.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_reviews=("review_id", "nunique"),
        avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        std_review_score=("review_score", "std"),
        review_response_rate=("review_answer_timestamp", lambda x: x.notna().mean())
    ).reset_index()
    
    # --------------------------
    # 3. Aggregate Payment Features
    # --------------------------
    filtered_payments = db["payments"][db["payments"]["order_id"].isin(valid_orders)].copy()
    # Link payments to products via order_items
    payment_product = filtered_payments.merge(
        filtered_order_items[["order_id", "product_id"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    
    payment_agg = payment_product.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_payments=("payment_sequential", "count"),
        avg_payment_value=("payment_value", "mean"),
        avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        most_common_payment_type=("payment_type", lambda x: x.mode()[0] if not x.mode().empty else "unknown")
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Encode categorical payment type as numeric code
    payment_agg["payment_type_code"] = pd.factorize(payment_agg["most_common_payment_type"])[0]
    payment_agg = payment_agg.drop(columns=["most_common_payment_type"])
    
    # --------------------------
    # 4. Aggregate Order & Delivery Features
    # --------------------------
    filtered_orders = db["orders"][db["orders"]["order_id"].isin(valid_orders)].copy()
    # Link orders to products via order_items
    order_product = filtered_orders.merge(
        filtered_order_items[["order_id", "product_id"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    
    # Calculate delivery timing metrics
    order_product["purchase_to_approval_days"] = (
        order_product["order_approved_at"] - order_product["order_purchase_timestamp"]
    ).dt.days
    order_product["purchase_to_carrier_days"] = (
        order_product["order_delivered_carrier_date"] - order_product["order_purchase_timestamp"]
    ).dt.days
    order_product["purchase_to_customer_days"] = (
        order_product["order_delivered_customer_date"] - order_product["order_purchase_timestamp"]
    ).dt.days
    order_product["estimated_vs_actual_days"] = (
        order_product["order_estimated_delivery_date"] - order_product["order_delivered_customer_date"]
    ).dt.days  # Positive = delivered early, negative = late
    
    # Status frequency features
    status_agg = order_product.groupby(["product_id", "order_status"]).agg(
        status_count=("order_id", "nunique")
    ).reset_index()
    status_pivot = status_agg.pivot(
        index="product_id",
        columns="order_status",
        values="status_count"
    ).reset_index().fillna(0)
    status_pivot.columns = [
        f"order_status_{col}" if col != "product_id" else col
        for col in status_pivot.columns
    ]
    
    # Delivery performance aggregations
    delivery_agg = order_product.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_purchase_to_approval_days=("purchase_to_approval_days", "mean"),
        avg_purchase_to_carrier_days=("purchase_to_carrier_days", "mean"),
        avg_purchase_to_customer_days=("purchase_to_customer_days", "mean"),
        avg_estimated_vs_actual_days=("estimated_vs_actual_days", "mean"),
        on_time_delivery_rate=("estimated_vs_actual_days", lambda x: (x >= 0).mean())
    ).reset_index()
    
    # --------------------------
    # 5. Merge all features and handle missing values
    # --------------------------
    # Initialize result with all input entity_ids (ensures full coverage)
    result = pd.DataFrame({"product_id": entity_ids}).set_index("product_id")
    
    # Merge all aggregated features with left join to preserve all input entity_ids
    aggregations = [
        (sales_agg, "product_id"),
        (review_agg, "product_id"),
        (payment_agg, "product_id"),
        (delivery_agg, "product_id"),
        (status_pivot, "product_id")
    ]
    for agg_df, key_col in aggregations:
        agg_idx = agg_df.set_index(key_col)
        result = result.join(agg_idx, how="left")
    
    # --------------------------
    # 6. Impute missing values and add synthetic features
    # --------------------------
    # Fill count-based columns with 0 (no activity)
    count_cols = [
        "total_orders", "total_items", "total_revenue", "total_freight",
        "unique_sellers", "orders_30d", "orders_60d", "orders_90d",
        "total_reviews", "total_payments"
    ]
    status_cols = [col for col in result.columns if col.startswith("order_status_")]
    count_cols.extend(status_cols)
    result[count_cols] = result[count_cols].fillna(0)
    
    # Fill average/ratio columns with 0 (neutral value for no activity)
    avg_cols = [
        "avg_price", "std_price", "avg_freight", "avg_review_score",
        "std_review_score", "avg_payment_value", "avg_installments",
        "avg_purchase_to_approval_days", "avg_purchase_to_carrier_days",
        "avg_purchase_to_customer_days", "avg_estimated_vs_actual_days",
        "on_time_delivery_rate", "review_response_rate",
        "ratio_30_to_90", "ratio_60_to_90"
    ]
    result[avg_cols] = result[avg_cols].fillna(0)
    
    # Fill recency columns with large value (simulate "cold" product with no history)
    max_recency_days = (seed_time - pd.Timestamp("2016-01-01")).days
    result[["days_since_first_sale", "days_since_last_sale"]] = result[
        ["days_since_first_sale", "days_since_last_sale"]
    ].fillna(max_recency_days)
    
    # Fill payment type code with -1 (unknown category)
    result["payment_type_code"] = result["payment_type_code"].fillna(-1).astype(int)
    
    # Synthetic derived features for signal strength
    result["has_sales_history"] = (result["total_orders"] > 0).astype(int)
    result["recency_score"] = 1 / (result["days_since_last_sale"] + 1)  # Normalized 0-1: higher = more recent
    result["frequency_score"] = (result["total_orders"] / (result["days_since_first_sale"] + 1)) * 30  # Avg orders per 30 days
    result["monetary_score"] = result["total_revenue"] / (result["total_orders"] + 1)  # Avg revenue per order
    
    # --------------------------
    # 7. Finalize output: reindex to match input entity_ids order
    # --------------------------
    result = result.reindex(entity_ids)
    return result

        delivered_orders=("order_delivered_customer_date", lambda x: x.notna().sum()),
        in_flight_orders=("order_id", "nunique")
    ).reset_index()
    delivery_agg["in_flight_share"] = 1 - delivery_agg["delivered_orders"] / (delivery_agg["in_flight_orders"] + 1e-9)
    delivery_agg = delivery_agg.drop(columns=["delivered_orders", "in_flight_orders"])

    # --------------------------
    # 5. Merge everything
    # --------------------------
    result = pd.DataFrame({"product_id": entity_ids}).set_index("product_id")
    for agg_df in [sales_agg, review_agg, payment_agg, delivery_agg, status_pivot]:

    ]

    count_cols.extend(status_cols)
    result[count_cols] = result[count_cols].fillna(0)

    avg_cols = [
        "avg_price", "std_price", "avg_freight", "avg_review_score",
        "std_review_score", "min_review_score", "bad_review_rate",
        "avg_payment_value", "avg_installments", "credit_card_share",
        "avg_purchase_to_approval_days", "avg_purchase_to_carrier_days",
        "avg_purchase_to_customer_days", "avg_estimated_vs_actual_days",
        "on_time_delivery_rate", "in_flight_share",
        "ratio_30_to_90", "ratio_60_to_90", "trend_90d"
    ]
    for c in avg_cols:
        if c in result.columns:
            result[c] = result[c].fillna(0)

    max_recency_days = (seed_time - pd.Timestamp("2016-09-01")).days
    result[["days_since_first_sale", "days_since_last_sale"]] = result[
        ["days_since_first_sale", "days_since_last_sale"]
    ].fillna(max_recency_days)

    result["has_sales_history"] = (result["total_orders"] > 0).astype(int)
    result["recency_score"] = 1 / (result["days_since_last_sale"] + 1)
    result["frequency_score"] = (result["total_orders"] / (result["days_since_first_sale"] + 1)) * 30
    result["monetary_score"] = result["total_revenue"] / (result["total_orders"] + 1)

    # Final numeric-only guarantee
    result = result.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0)
    result = result.reindex(entity_ids)
    return result

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Define historical window (1 year prior to seed time)
    start_hist = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=365)
    
    # Filter order items to historical window
    oi_hist = db["order_items"].query(
        "ts >= @start_hist and ts < @seed_time"
    ).copy()
    
    # Merge with orders for delivery/status data
    oi_orders = oi_hist.merge(
        db["orders"][[
            "order_id", 
            "order_status", 
            "order_delivered_customer_date", 
            "order_estimated_delivery_date"
        ]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    
    # Calculate delivery delay (days)
    oi_orders["delivery_delay_days"] = (
        oi_orders["order_delivered_customer_date"] 
        - oi_orders["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    # Fill NaN for undelivered orders with extreme delay
    oi_orders["delivery_delay_days"] = oi_orders["delivery_delay_days"].fillna(999.0)
    
    # Merge with reviews for score data
    oi_reviews = oi_orders.merge(
        db["reviews"][["order_id", "review_score"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    # Fill missing reviews with neutral score
    oi_reviews["review_score"] = oi_reviews["review_score"].fillna(3.0)
    
    # Aggregate payment data per order
    payments_agg = db["payments"].groupby("order_id").agg(
        total_payment=("payment_value", "sum"),

    result = result.set_index("product_id").reindex(entity_ids)
    
    # Ensure all columns are numeric
    result = result.astype(np.float64)
    
    return result

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:

        "order_purchase_timestamp",
        "order_delivered_customer_date",
        "order_estimated_delivery_date"
    ]]

    )

        wg = w.groupby("product_id").agg(
            units=("order_item_id", "count"),

        )
        return wg

    w30 = window_stats(30)
    w90 = window_stats(90)
    # second half of history (recency trend)
    mid = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=182)
    recent_half = oi_f[oi_f["ts"] >= mid].groupby("product_id")["order_item_id"].count()
    older_half = oi_f[oi_f["ts"] < mid].groupby("product_id")["order_item_id"].count()

    wf = product_features
    wf["units_30d"] = w30["units"].reindex(wf.index).fillna(0.0)
    wf["orders_30d"] = w30["orders"].reindex(wf.index).fillna(0.0)
    wf["revenue_30d"] = w30["revenue"].reindex(wf.index).fillna(0.0)
    wf["units_90d"] = w90["units"].reindex(wf.index).fillna(0.0)
    wf["revenue_90d"] = w90["revenue"].reindex(wf.index).fillna(0.0)
    wf["recent_half_units"] = recent_half.reindex(wf.index).fillna(0.0)
    wf["older_half_units"] = older_half.reindex(wf.index).fillna(0.0)
    wf["trend_ratio"] = wf["recent_half_units"] / (wf["older_half_units"] + 1.0)
    wf["days_since_last_sale"] = (
        seed_time - oi_f.groupby("product_id")["ts"].max()
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    wf["days_since_first_sale"] = (
        seed_time - oi_f.groupby("product_id")["ts"].min()
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    wf["has_history"] = 1.0

    wf = wf.drop(columns=["freight_ratio_placeholder"], errors="ignore")
    wf = wf.reset_index()

    result = pd.DataFrame({"product_id": list(entity_ids)}).merge(
        wf, on="product_id", how="left"
    )

    # fills for products without history / missing values
    for c in ["avg_review_score"]:
        result[c] = result[c].fillna(3.0)
    result["min_review_score"] = result["min_review_score"].fillna(3.0)
    for c in ["std_price", "avg_delivery_delay", "max_delivery_delay",
              "avg_delivery_time"]:
        result[c] = result[c].fillna(0.0)
    result = result.fillna(0.0)

    result = result.set_index("product_id").reindex(entity_ids)
    result = result.astype(np.float64)
    return result

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Unpack database tables
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]
    
    # ----------------------
    # Preprocess Payments: aggregate per order
    # ----------------------
    # Aggregate payment numerical metrics per order
    payments_agg = payments.groupby("order_id").agg(
        total_order_payment=("payment_value", "sum"),
        avg_payment_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        num_payment_sequentials=("payment_sequential", "count")
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Create payment type percentage features
    payment_type_dummies = pd.get_dummies(payments[["order_id", "payment_type"]], columns=["payment_type"])
    payment_type_dummies = payment_type_dummies.groupby("order_id").sum().reset_index()
    
    # Merge payment metrics
    payments_agg = payments_agg.merge(payment_type_dummies, on="order_id", how="left")
    # Normalize payment type counts to percentages
    payment_type_cols = [c for c in payment_type_dummies.columns if c.startswith("payment_type_")]
    for col in payment_type_cols:
        payments_agg[f"{col}_pct"] = payments_agg[col] / payments_agg["num_payment_sequentials"]
    # Drop raw count columns
    payments_agg = payments_agg.drop(columns=payment_type_cols + ["num_payment_sequentials"])
    
    # ----------------------
    # Preprocess Reviews: aggregate per order
    # ----------------------
    # Merge reviews with order timestamps to compute review delay
    reviews_with_order = reviews.merge(
        orders[["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    reviews_with_order["days_to_review_creation"] = (
        reviews_with_order["review_creation_date"] - reviews_with_order["order_purchase_timestamp"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)  # Convert to days
    
    # Aggregate review metrics per order
    reviews_agg = reviews_with_order.groupby("order_id").agg(
        avg_order_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        total_reviews_per_order=("review_id", "count"),
        pct_reviews_with_title=("review_comment_title", lambda x: x.notna().mean()),
        pct_reviews_with_message=("review_comment_message", lambda x: x.notna().mean()),
        avg_days_to_review=("days_to_review_creation", "mean")
    ).reset_index()
    
    # ----------------------
    # Create base dataset with all order-item details
    # ----------------------
    # Merge order-items with order metadata
    order_items_orders = order_items.merge(
        orders[["order_id", "customer_id", "order_status", 
                "order_purchase_timestamp", "order_delivered_carrier_date", 
                "order_delivered_customer_date", "order_estimated_delivery_date"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )
    
    # Filter to orders strictly before seed time
    order_items_orders = order_items_orders[order_items_orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time].copy()
    
    # Merge with payment and review data
    order_items_full = order_items_orders.merge(payments_agg, on="order_id", how="left")
    order_items_full = order_items_full.merge(reviews_agg, on="order_id", how="left")
    
    # ----------------------
    # Engineer derived delivery and status features
    # ----------------------
    order_items_full["days_to_carrier"] = (
        order_items_full["order_delivered_carrier_date"] - order_items_full["order_purchase_timestamp"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    order_items_full["days_carrier_to_customer"] = (
        order_items_full["order_delivered_customer_date"] - order_items_full["order_delivered_carrier_date"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    order_items_full["delivery_delay_days"] = (
        order_items_full["order_delivered_customer_date"] - order_items_full["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    
    # Binary status flags
    order_items_full["is_canceled"] = (order_items_full["order_status"] == "canceled").astype(int)
    order_items_full["is_delivered"] = (order_items_full["order_status"] == "delivered").astype(int)
    order_items_full["is_late"] = (order_items_full["delivery_delay_days"] > 0).astype(int)
    
    # ----------------------
    # Define lookback windows
    # ----------------------
    lookback_windows = [
        ("7d", pd.Timedelta(days=7)),
        ("14d", pd.Timedelta(days=14)),
        ("30d", pd.Timedelta(days=30)),
        ("90d", pd.Timedelta(days=90)),
        ("180d", pd.Timedelta(days=180)),
        ("all", None)  # All historical data before seed_time
    ]
    window_names = [win[0] for win in lookback_windows]
    
    # ----------------------
    # Initialize output with full entity list
    # ----------------------
    base_features = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)
    base_features.index.name = "product_id"
    
    # ----------------------
    # Compute features per lookback window
    # ----------------------
    for window_name, window_delta in lookback_windows:
        # Filter to current window
        if window_delta is not None:
            start_time = seed_time - window_delta
            window_data = order_items_full[
                (order_items_full["order_purchase_timestamp"] >= start_time) &
                (order_items_full["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time)
            ].copy()
        else:
            window_data = order_items_full.copy()
        
        # Skip if no data in window (will be filled later)
        if window_data.empty:
            continue
        
        # ----------------------
        # Line-item level features (per product)
        # ----------------------
        line_item_feats = window_data.groupby("product_id").agg(
            total_units=("order_item_id", "count"),
            unique_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
            unique_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
            unique_customers=("customer_id", "nunique"),
            total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
            total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
            avg_unit_price=("price", "mean"),
            avg_unit_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
            last_sale_time=("order_purchase_timestamp", "max"),
            first_sale_time=("order_purchase_timestamp", "min")
        ).reset_index()
        
        # Time-based features
        line_item_feats["days_since_last_sale"] = (
            seed_time - line_item_feats["last_sale_time"]
        ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
        line_item_feats["product_age_days"] = (
            seed_time - line_item_feats["first_sale_time"]
        ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
        line_item_feats = line_item_feats.drop(columns=["last_sale_time", "first_sale_time"])
        
        # ----------------------
        # Order-level features (per product, unique orders)
        # ----------------------
        unique_product_orders = window_data[
            ["product_id", "order_id", "is_canceled", "is_delivered", "is_late",
             "days_to_carrier", "days_carrier_to_customer", "delivery_delay_days",
             "total_order_payment", "avg_payment_installments",
             "payment_type_credit_card_pct", "payment_type_boleto_pct",
             "payment_type_voucher_pct", "payment_type_debit_card_pct",
             "avg_order_review_score", "total_reviews_per_order",
             "pct_reviews_with_title", "pct_reviews_with_message", "avg_days_to_review"]
        ].drop_duplicates(subset=["product_id", "order_id"])
        
        order_level_feats = unique_product_orders.groupby("product_id").agg(
            pct_canceled_orders=("is_canceled", "mean"),
            pct_delivered_orders=("is_delivered", "mean"),
            pct_late_deliveries=("is_late", "mean"),
            avg_days_to_carrier=("days_to_carrier", "mean"),
            avg_days_carrier_to_customer=("days_carrier_to_customer", "mean"),
            avg_delivery_delay=("delivery_delay_days", "mean"),
            avg_total_order_payment=("total_order_payment", "mean"),
            avg_payment_installments=("avg_payment_installments", "mean"),
            avg_pct_credit_card=("payment_type_credit_card_pct", "mean"),
            avg_pct_boleto=("payment_type_boleto_pct", "mean"),
            avg_pct_voucher=("payment_type_voucher_pct", "mean"),
            avg_pct_debit_card=("payment_type_debit_card_pct", "mean"),
            avg_review_score=("avg_order_review_score", "mean"),
            total_reviews=("total_reviews_per_order", "sum"),
            avg_pct_reviews_with_titles=("pct_reviews_with_title", "mean"),
            avg_pct_reviews_with_messages=("pct_reviews_with_message", "mean"),
            avg_days_to_review=("avg_days_to_review", "mean")
        ).reset_index()
        
        # ----------------------
        # Merge window features
        # ----------------------
        window_features = line_item_feats.merge(order_level_feats, on="product_id", how="outer")
        # Rename columns with window suffix
        rename_map = {col: f"{col}_{window_name}" for col in window_features.columns if col!= "product_id"}
        window_features = window_features.rename(columns=rename_map)
        window_features = window_features.set_index("product_id")
        
        # Join to base features
        base_features = base_features.join(window_features, how="left")
    
    # ----------------------
    # Create indicator features for data availability
    # ----------------------
    for win in window_names:
        sales_col = f"total_units_{win}"
        review_col = f"total_reviews_{win}"
        base_features[f"has_sales_{win}"] = (base_features[sales_col] > 0).astype(int) if sales_col in base_features.columns else 0
        base_features[f"has_reviews_{win}"] = (base_features[review_col] > 0).astype(int) if review_col in base_features.columns else 0
    
    # ----------------------
    # Handle missing values
    # ----------------------
    # Indicator columns: fill NaNs with 0
    indicator_cols = [c for c in base_features.columns if c.startswith("has_")]
    base_features[indicator_cols] = base_features[indicator_cols].fillna(0).astype(int)
    
    # Count/sum columns: fill NaNs with 0
    count_sum_keys = ["total_units", "unique_orders", "unique_sellers", "unique_customers", 
                      "total_revenue", "total_freight", "total_reviews"]
    count_sum_cols = [c for c in base_features.columns if any(k in c for k in count_sum_keys)]
    base_features[count_sum_cols] = base_features[count_sum_cols].fillna(0)
    
    # Days since last sale: fill with large value (1e5 days = ~273 years)
    days_since_cols = [c for c in base_features.columns if "days_since_last_sale" in c]
    base_features[days_since_cols] = base_features[days_since_cols].fillna(1e5)
    
    # Product age: fill with 0 (no prior sales)
    age_cols = [c for c in base_features.columns if "product_age_days" in c]
    base_features[age_cols] = base_features[age_cols].fillna(0)
    
    # All remaining columns: fill with 0
    remaining_cols = [c for c in base_features.columns 
                      if c not in count_sum_cols + days_since_cols + age_cols + indicator_cols]
    base_features[remaining_cols] = base_features[remaining_cols].fillna(0)
    
    # ----------------------
    # Finalize output to match required entity list
    # ----------------------
    base_features = base_features.reindex(entity_ids)
    base_features.index.name = "product_id"
    
    return base_features

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"].copy()
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    # ----------------------
    # Orders: keep only what is known at seed_time.
    # Status of a "delivered" order is only known once delivery happened;
    # carrier date only once handed to carrier.
    # ----------------------
    orders_k = orders.copy()
    known_delivery = orders_k["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna() & (orders_k["order_delivered_customer_date"] < seed_time)
    known_carrier = orders_k["order_delivered_carrier_date"].notna() & (orders_k["order_delivered_carrier_date"] < seed_time)
    # A status other than a pre-delivery status is only reliable after the corresponding event
    orders_k["status_known_delivered"] = known_delivery
    # Mask dates that are in the future relative to seed_time (shouldn't exist but be safe)
    for col in ["order_approved_at", "order_delivered_carrier_date", "order_delivered_customer_date", "order_estimated_delivery_date"]:
        orders_k.loc[orders_k[col] >= seed_time, col] = pd.NaT
    # Status: if delivery not yet known, treat anything after "shipped" as not yet determinable
    orders_k.loc[~known_carrier & orders_k["order_status"].isin(["shipped", "delivered"]), "order_status"] = "shipped"
    orders_k.loc[~known_delivery & (orders_k["order_status"] == "delivered"), "order_status"] = "shipped"

    # ----------------------
    # Payments: only payments recorded before seed_time.
    # payments.ts is the purchase time of the order; a payment for an order
    # bought before seed_time but approved later is not fully knowable.
    # Use ts < seed_time as the availability criterion.
    # ----------------------
    payments_k = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time].copy()

    payments_agg = payments_k.groupby("order_id").agg(
        total_order_payment=("payment_value", "sum"),
        avg_payment_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        num_payment_sequentials=("payment_sequential", "count")
    ).reset_index()

    payment_type_dummies = pd.get_dummies(payments_k[["order_id", "payment_type"]], columns=["payment_type"])
    payment_type_dummies = payment_type_dummies.groupby("order_id").sum().reset_index()
    payments_agg = payments_agg.merge(payment_type_dummies, on="order_id", how="left")
    payment_type_cols = [c for c in payment_type_dummies.columns if c.startswith("payment_type_")]
    for col in payment_type_cols:
        payments_agg[f"{col}_pct"] = payments_agg[col] / payments_agg["num_payment_sequentials"]
    payments_agg = payments_agg.drop(columns=payment_type_cols + ["num_payment_sequentials"])
    # Fill pct columns for orders with no payment rows later; here ensure columns exist
    for base_t in ["credit_card", "boleto", "voucher", "debit_card"]:
        col = f"payment_type_{base_t}_pct"
        if col not in payments_agg.columns:
            payments_agg[col] = 0.0

    # ----------------------
    # Reviews: a review is only visible once it was created (< seed_time)
    # ----------------------
    reviews_k = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time].copy()
    reviews_k = reviews_k.merge(
        orders_k[["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp"]],
        on="order_id", how="left"
    )
    reviews_k["days_to_review_creation"] = (
        reviews_k["review_creation_date"] - reviews_k["order_purchase_timestamp"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)

    reviews_agg = reviews_k.groupby("order_id").agg(
        avg_order_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        total_reviews_per_order=("review_id", "count"),
        pct_reviews_with_title=("review_comment_title", lambda x: x.notna().mean()),
        pct_reviews_with_message=("review_comment_message", lambda x: x.notna().mean()),
        avg_days_to_review=("days_to_review_creation", "mean")
    ).reset_index()

    # ----------------------
    # Base: order items with purchase time (ts) strictly before seed_time
    # ----------------------
    order_items = order_items[order_items["ts"] < seed_time].copy()

    order_items_orders = order_items.merge(
        orders_k[["order_id", "customer_id", "order_status",
                  "order_purchase_timestamp", "order_delivered_carrier_date",
                  "order_delivered_customer_date", "order_estimated_delivery_date",
                  "status_known_delivered"]],
        on="order_id", how="inner"
    )

    order_items_full = order_items_orders.merge(payments_agg, on="order_id", how="left")
    order_items_full = order_items_full.merge(reviews_agg, on="order_id", how="left")

    # Delivery timing features: only meaningful if delivery already happened before seed_time
    delivered_mask = order_items_full["status_known_delivered"].fillna(False)

    order_items_full["days_to_carrier"] = np.where(
        delivered_mask & order_items_full["order_delivered_carrier_date"].notna(),
        (order_items_full["order_delivered_carrier_date"] - order_items_full["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0,
        np.nan
    )
    order_items_full["days_carrier_to_customer"] = np.where(
        delivered_mask & order_items_full["order_delivered_carrier_date"].notna() & order_items_full["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna(),
        (order_items_full["order_delivered_customer_date"] - order_items_full["order_delivered_carrier_date"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0,
        np.nan
    )
    order_items_full["delivery_delay_days"] = np.where(
        delivered_mask & order_items_full["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna(),
        (order_items_full["order_delivered_customer_date"] - order_items_full["order_estimated_delivery_date"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0,
        np.nan
    )

    order_items_full["is_canceled"] = (order_items_full["order_status"] == "canceled").astype(int)
    order_items_full["is_delivered"] = (order_items_full["order_status"] == "delivered").astype(int)
    order_items_full["is_late"] = np.where(
        delivered_mask,
        (order_items_full["delivery_delay_days"] > 0).astype(float),
        np.nan
    )

    # ----------------------
    # Lookback windows based on purchase time (ts)
    # ----------------------
    lookback_windows = [
        ("7d", pd.Timedelta(days=7)),
        ("14d", pd.Timedelta(days=14)),
        ("30d", pd.Timedelta(days=30)),
        ("90d", pd.Timedelta(days=90)),
        ("180d", pd.Timedelta(days=180)),
        ("all", None)
    ]
    window_names = [w[0] for w in lookback_windows]

    base_features = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"))

    order_level_cols = ["is_canceled", "is_delivered", "is_late",
                        "days_to_carrier", "days_carrier_to_customer", "delivery_delay_days",
                        "total_order_payment", "avg_payment_installments",
                        "payment_type_credit_card_pct", "payment_type_boleto_pct",
                        "payment_type_voucher_pct", "payment_type_debit_card_pct",
                        "avg_order_review_score", "total_reviews_per_order",
                        "pct_reviews_with_title", "pct_reviews_with_message", "avg_days_to_review"]

    for window_name, window_delta in lookback_windows:
        if window_delta is not None:
            start_time = seed_time - window_delta
            window_data = order_items_full[
                (order_items_full["ts"] >= start_time) & (order_items_full["ts"] < seed_time)
            ].copy()
        else:
            window_data = order_items_full.copy()

        if window_data.empty:
            continue

        line_item_feats = window_data.groupby("product_id").agg(
            total_units=("order_item_id", "count"),
            unique_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
            unique_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
            unique_customers=("customer_id", "nunique"),
            total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
            total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
            avg_unit_price=("price", "mean"),
            avg_unit_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
            last_sale_time=("ts", "max"),
            first_sale_time=("ts", "min")
        ).reset_index()

        line_item_feats["days_since_last_sale"] = (
            seed_time - line_item_feats["last_sale_time"]
        ).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
        line_item_feats["product_age_days"] = (
            seed_time - line_item_feats["first_sale_time"]
        ).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
        line_item_feats = line_item_feats.drop(columns=["last_sale_time", "first_sale_time"])

        existing_cols = [c for c in order_level_cols if c in window_data.columns]
        unique_product_orders = window_data[["product_id", "order_id"] + existing_cols].drop_duplicates(
            subset=["product_id", "order_id"]
        )

        order_level_feats = unique_product_orders.groupby("product_id").agg(
            pct_canceled_orders=("is_canceled", "mean"),
            pct_delivered_orders=("is_delivered", "mean"),
            pct_late_deliveries=("is_late", "mean"),
            avg_days_to_carrier=("days_to_carrier", "mean"),
            avg_days_carrier_to_customer=("days_carrier_to_customer", "mean"),
            avg_delivery_delay=("delivery_delay_days", "mean"),
            avg_total_order_payment=("total_order_payment", "mean"),
            avg_payment_installments=("avg_payment_installments", "mean"),
            avg_pct_credit_card=("payment_type_credit_card_pct", "mean"),
            avg_pct_boleto=("payment_type_boleto_pct", "mean"),
            avg_pct_voucher=("payment_type_voucher_pct", "mean"),
            avg_pct_debit_card=("payment_type_debit_card_pct", "mean"),
            avg_review_score=("avg_order_review_score", "mean"),
            total_reviews=("total_reviews_per_order", "sum"),
            avg_pct_reviews_with_titles=("pct_reviews_with_title", "mean"),
            avg_pct_reviews_with_messages=("pct_reviews_with_message", "mean"),
            avg_days_to_review=("avg_days_to_review", "mean")
        ).reset_index()

        window_features = line_item_feats.merge(order_level_feats, on="product_id", how="outer")
        rename_map = {col: f"{col}_{window_name}" for col in window_features.columns if col != "product_id"}
        window_features = window_features.rename(columns=rename_map).set_index("product_id")

        base_features = base_features.join(window_features, how="left")

    # ----------------------
    # Availability indicators
    # ----------------------
    for win in window_names:
        sales_col = f"total_units_{win}"
        review_col = f"total_reviews_{win}"
        base_features[f"has_sales_{win}"] = (base_features[sales_col] > 0).astype(int) if sales_col in base_features.columns else 0
        base_features[f"has_reviews_{win}"] = (base_features[review_col] > 0).astype(int) if review_col in base_features.columns else 0

    # ----------------------
    # Missing value handling
    # ----------------------
    indicator_cols = [c for c in base_features.columns if c.startswith("has_")]
    base_features[indicator_cols] = base_features[indicator_cols].fillna(0).astype(int)

    count_sum_keys = ["total_units", "unique_orders", "unique_sellers", "unique_customers",
                      "total_revenue", "total_freight", "total_reviews"]
    count_sum_cols = [c for c in base_features.columns if any(k in c for k in count_sum_keys)]
    base_features[count_sum_cols] = base_features[count_sum_cols].fillna(0)

    days_since_cols = [c for c in base_features.columns if "days_since_last_sale" in c]
    base_features[days_since_cols] = base_features[days_since_cols].fillna(1e5)

    age_cols = [c for c in base_features.columns if "product_age_days" in c]
    base_features[age_cols] = base_features[age_cols].fillna(0)

    remaining_cols = [c for c in base_features.columns
                      if c not in count_sum_cols + days_since_cols + age_cols + indicator_cols]
    base_features[remaining_cols] = base_features[remaining_cols].fillna(0)

    base_features = base_features.reindex(entity_ids)
    base_features.index.name = "product_id"

    return base_features

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Define lookback windows
    lookback_90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    lookback_180 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)
    
    # Extract table references
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    
    # Filter relevant order items
    relevant_items = order_items[order_items["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)]
    # Merge with orders to get purchase timestamps and status
    items_full = relevant_items.merge(
        orders[["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp", "order_status"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    # Filter to items purchased before seed time
    items_historic = items_full[items_full["order_purchase_timestamp"] <= seed_time]
    
    # 90-day lookback features
    items_90 = items_historic[items_historic["order_purchase_timestamp"] > lookback_90]
    agg_90 = items_90.groupby("product_id").agg(
        units_sold_90=("order_item_id", "count"),
        revenue_90=("price", "sum"),
        avg_price_90=("price", "mean"),
        total_freight_90=("freight_value", "sum"),
        unique_orders_90=("order_id", "nunique")
    ).reset_index()
    
    # 180-day lookback features
    items_180 = items_historic[items_historic["order_purchase_timestamp"] > lookback_180]
    agg_180 = items_180.groupby("product_id").agg(
        units_sold_180=("order_item_id", "count"),
        revenue_180=("price", "sum"),
        avg_price_180=("price", "mean"),
        total_freight_180=("freight_value", "sum"),
        unique_orders_180=("order_id", "nunique")
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Recency feature
    last_purchase = items_historic.groupby("product_id")["order_purchase_timestamp"].max().reset_index()
    last_purchase["recency_days"] = (seed_time - last_purchase["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.days
    recency = last_purchase[["product_id", "recency_days"]]
    
    # Review features
    items_with_reviews = items_historic.merge(
        reviews[["order_id", "review_score"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    review_agg = items_with_reviews.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_review=("review_score", "mean"),
        total_reviews=("review_score", "count")
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Create base dataframe with all entity IDs
    final_features = pd.DataFrame({"product_id": entity_ids})
    
    # Merge all feature groups
    for df in [agg_90, agg_180, recency, review_agg]:
        final_features = final_features.merge(df, on="product_id", how="left")
    
    # Set index to product ID (matches entity_ids)
    final_features = final_features.set_index("product_id")
    
    # Fill missing values for products with no history
    fill_zero_cols = [
        "units_sold_90", "revenue_90", "avg_price_90", "total_freight_90", "unique_orders_90",
        "units_sold_180", "revenue_180", "avg_price_180", "total_freight_180", "unique_orders_180",
        "avg_review", "total_reviews"
    ]
    for col in fill_zero_cols:
        final_features[col] = final_features[col].fillna(0)
    
    # Fill recency with a large value (no recent sales)
    final_features["recency_days"] = final_features["recency_days"].fillna(365)
    
    # Reindex to ensure exact entity_ids order (requirement compliance)
    final_features = final_features.reindex(entity_ids)
    
    return final_features
