import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    lookback_30 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    lookback_90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    lookback_180 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)
    lookback_365 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=365)

    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]

    relevant_items = order_items[order_items["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)]
    items_full = relevant_items.merge(
        orders[["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp", "order_status"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left",
    )
    # Только покупки, совершённые до seed_time
    items_historic = items_full[items_full["order_purchase_timestamp"] <= seed_time].copy()

    def agg_window(df, suffix):
        if len(df) == 0:
            return pd.DataFrame({
                "product_id": pd.Series(dtype=object),
                f"units_sold_{suffix}": pd.Series(dtype=float),
                f"revenue_{suffix}": pd.Series(dtype=float),
                f"avg_price_{suffix}": pd.Series(dtype=float),
                f"total_freight_{suffix}": pd.Series(dtype=float),
                f"unique_orders_{suffix}": pd.Series(dtype=float),
                f"unique_buyers_{suffix}": pd.Series(dtype=float),
            })
        out = df.groupby("product_id").agg(
            **{
                f"units_sold_{suffix}": ("order_item_id", "count"),
                f"revenue_{suffix}": ("price", "sum"),
                f"avg_price_{suffix}": ("price", "mean"),
                f"total_freight_{suffix}": ("freight_value", "sum"),
                f"unique_orders_{suffix}": ("order_id", "nunique"),
                f"unique_buyers_{suffix}": ("price", "size"),
            }
        ).reset_index()
        return out

    windows = {
        "30d": lookback_30,
        "90d": lookback_90,
        "180d": lookback_180,
        "365d": lookback_365,
    }
    aggs = []
    for suffix, start in windows.items():
        w = items_historic[items_historic["order_purchase_timestamp"] > start]
        aggs.append(agg_window(w, suffix))

    # Полнота истории
    total_units = items_historic.groupby("product_id")["order_item_id"].count().rename("units_total")

    # Recency
    last_purchase = items_historic.groupby("product_id")["order_purchase_timestamp"].max()
    first_purchase = items_historic.groupby("product_id")["order_purchase_timestamp"].min()
    recency = ((seed_time - last_purchase).dt.days).rename("recency_days")
    age_days = ((seed_time - first_purchase).dt.days).rename("history_days")

    # Отзывы: используем только те, что УЖЕ созданы к моменту seed_time
    reviews_avail = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] <= seed_time][["order_id", "review_score"]]
    items_reviews = items_historic[["order_id", "product_id"]].merge(
        reviews_avail, on="order_id", how="inner"
    )
    review_agg = items_reviews.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_review=("review_score", "mean"),
        total_reviews=("review_score", "count"),
        min_review=("review_score", "min"),
    ).reset_index()

    # Свежие отзывы (за 90 дней до seed_time)
    rev_90 = items_reviews.merge(
        reviews[["order_id", "review_creation_date"]], on="order_id", how="left"
    )
    rev_90 = rev_90[rev_90["review_creation_date"] > lookback_90]
    review_90_agg = rev_90.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_review_90=("review_score", "mean"),
        n_reviews_90=("review_score", "count"),
    ).reset_index()

    final_features = pd.DataFrame({"product_id": list(entity_ids)})

    for agg in aggs:
        final_features = final_features.merge(agg, on="product_id", how="left")
    for ser, name in [(total_units, "units_total"), (recency, "recency_days"), (age_days, "history_days")]:
        final_features = final_features.merge(ser.rename(name).reset_index(), on="product_id", how="left")
    final_features = final_features.merge(review_agg, on="product_id", how="left")
    final_features = final_features.merge(review_90_agg, on="product_id", how="left")

    # Производные признаки
    if "units_sold_90" in final_features and "units_sold_180" in final_features:
        final_features["sales_accel_90_180"] = (
            final_features["units_sold_90"] / 90.0
            - final_features["units_sold_180"] / 180.0
        )
    if "units_sold_30" in final_features:
        final_features["sales_accel_30_90"] = (
            final_features["units_sold_30"] / 30.0
            - final_features["units_sold_90"] / 90.0
        )
    final_features["review_gap_90"] = final_features["avg_review_90"] - final_features["avg_review"]

    fill_zero_cols = [
        "units_sold_30d", "revenue_30d", "avg_price_30d", "total_freight_30d",
        "unique_orders_30d", "unique_buyers_30d",
        "units_sold_90d", "revenue_90d", "avg_price_90d", "total_freight_90d",
        "unique_orders_90d", "unique_buyers_90d",
        "units_sold_180d", "revenue_180d", "avg_price_180d", "total_freight_180d",
        "unique_orders_180d", "unique_buyers_180d",
        "units_sold_365d", "revenue_365d", "avg_price_365d", "total_freight_365d",
        "unique_orders_365d", "unique_buyers_365d",
        "units_total", "avg_review", "total_reviews", "min_review",
        "avg_review_90", "n_reviews_90",
        "sales_accel_90_180", "sales_accel_30_90", "review_gap_90",
    ]
    for col in fill_zero_cols:
        if col in final_features.columns:
            final_features[col] = final_features[col].fillna(0)

    final_features["recency_days"] = final_features["recency_days"].fillna(3650)
    final_features["history_days"] = final_features["history_days"].fillna(0)

    final_features = final_features.set_index("product_id")
    final_features = final_features.reindex(entity_ids)
    final_features = final_features.fillna(0).astype(float)

    return final_features

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Extract tables from the database
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]
    
    # Filter order items to only those before seed_time (historical data)
    oi_hist = order_items[order_items["ts"] < seed_time].copy()
    
    # Merge order items with orders to get customer and order status info
    oi_orders = pd.merge(
        oi_hist,
        orders[["order_id", "customer_id", "order_status"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    ).dropna(subset=["order_id", "customer_id"])  # Drop invalid rows (should be none)
    
    # Define time windows relative to seed_time
    win_30 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    win_90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    win_180 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)
    
    # ------------------------------
    # ALL-TIME HISTORICAL FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    prod_all = oi_orders.groupby("product_id").agg(
        # Count metrics
        total_units=("order_id", "count"),
        total_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_customers=("customer_id", "nunique"),
        # Price metrics
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        median_price=("price", "median"),
        max_price=("price", "max"),
        min_price=("price", "min"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
        # Freight metrics
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        # Time metrics
        last_purchase_ts=("ts", "max"),
        first_purchase_ts=("ts", "min"),
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Compute time-since features
    prod_all["days_since_last_purchase"] = (seed_time - prod_all["last_purchase_ts"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    prod_all["days_since_first_purchase"] = (seed_time - prod_all["first_purchase_ts"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    prod_all["avg_units_per_order"] = prod_all["total_units"] / prod_all["total_orders"].replace(0, np.nan)
    
    # ------------------------------
    # WINDOWED HISTORICAL FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    # Last 30 days
    oi_30 = oi_orders[oi_orders["ts"] >= win_30].copy()
    prod_30 = oi_30.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units_30d=("order_id", "count"),
        total_orders_30d=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_revenue_30d=("price", "sum"),
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Last 90 days
    oi_90 = oi_orders[oi_orders["ts"] >= win_90].copy()
    prod_90 = oi_90.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units_90d=("order_id", "count"),
        total_orders_90d=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_customers_90d=("customer_id", "nunique"),
        total_revenue_90d=("price", "sum"),
        avg_price_90d=("price", "mean"),
        last_purchase_90d=("ts", "max"),
    ).reset_index()
    prod_90["days_since_last_purchase_90d"] = (seed_time - prod_90["last_purchase_90d"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    
    # Last 180 days
    oi_180 = oi_orders[oi_orders["ts"] >= win_180].copy()
    prod_180 = oi_180.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units_180d=("order_id", "count"),
        total_orders_180d=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_revenue_180d=("price", "sum"),
    ).reset_index()
    
    # ------------------------------
    # ORDER STATUS FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    order_status = oi_orders.groupby(["product_id", "order_status"]).agg(
        status_count=("order_id", "nunique")
    ).reset_index()
    order_status_pivot = order_status.pivot(
        index="product_id",
        columns="order_status",
        values="status_count"
    ).fillna(0).reset_index()
    order_status_pivot.columns = [
        f"order_status_{col.lower().replace(' ', '_')}" if col != "product_id" else col
        for col in order_status_pivot.columns
    ]
    
    # ------------------------------
    # REVIEW FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    oi_reviews = pd.merge(
        oi_orders[["product_id", "order_id"]],
        reviews[["order_id", "review_score", "review_comment_title", "review_comment_message"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    oi_reviews["has_comment"] = (
        oi_reviews["review_comment_title"].notna() | oi_reviews["review_comment_message"].notna()
    ).astype(int)
    review_features = oi_reviews.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_reviews=("review_score", "count"),
        avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        min_review_score=("review_score", "min"),
        max_review_score=("review_score", "max"),
        std_review_score=("review_score", "std"),
        frac_reviews_with_comment=("has_comment", "mean"),
    ).reset_index()
    
    # ------------------------------
    # PAYMENT FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    oi_payments = pd.merge(
        oi_orders[["product_id", "order_id"]],
        payments[["order_id", "payment_type", "payment_installments", "payment_value"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    # Aggregated payment features
    payment_features = oi_payments.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_payment_value=("payment_value", "sum"),
        avg_payment_value_per_item=("payment_value", "mean"),
        avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        max_installments=("payment_installments", "max"),
        num_unique_payment_types=("payment_type", "nunique"),
    ).reset_index()
    # Payment type dummy features
    oi_payments = pd.concat([
        oi_payments,
        pd.get_dummies(oi_payments["payment_type"], prefix="pay_type")
    ], axis=1)
    payment_type_features = oi_payments.groupby("product_id").agg(
        **{f"pay_{col}_count": (col, "sum") for col in oi_payments.columns if col.startswith("pay_type_")},
        **{f"pay_{col}_frac": (col, "mean") for col in oi_payments.columns if col.startswith("pay_type_")},
    ).reset_index()
    
    # ------------------------------
    # MERGE ALL FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    all_features = prod_all.copy()
    all_features = pd.merge(all_features, prod_30, on="product_id", how="outer")
    all_features = pd.merge(all_features, prod_90, on="product_id", how="outer")
    all_features = pd.merge(all_features, prod_180, on="product_id", how="outer")
    all_features = pd.merge(all_features, order_status_pivot, on="product_id", how="outer")
    all_features = pd.merge(all_features, review_features, on="product_id", how="outer")
    all_features = pd.merge(all_features, payment_features, on="product_id", how="outer")
    all_features = pd.merge(all_features, payment_type_features, on="product_id", how="outer")
    
    # ------------------------------
    # CREATE ADDITIONAL DERIVED FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    # Binary flag for any sales history
    all_features["has_any_sales"] = (~all_features["total_units"].isna()).astype(int)
    
    # Growth ratio features
    all_features["ratio_30d_to_90d_units"] = all_features["total_units_30d"] / all_features["total_units_90d"].replace(0, np.nan)
    all_features["ratio_90d_to_180d_units"] = all_features["total_units_90d"] / all_features["total_units_180d"].replace(0, np.nan)
    all_features["ratio_30d_to_all_units"] = all_features["total_units_30d"] / all_features["total_units"].replace(0, np.nan)
    all_features["ratio_90d_to_all_units"] = all_features["total_units_90d"] / all_features["total_units"].replace(0, np.nan)
    
    # Average order interval
    all_features["avg_days_between_orders"] = np.where(
        all_features["total_orders"] > 1,
        (all_features["days_since_first_purchase"] - all_features["days_since_last_purchase"]) / (all_features["total_orders"] - 1),
        0
    )
    
    # ------------------------------
    # CLEAN AND REINDEX TO INPUT ENTITIES
    # ------------------------------
    # Drop non-numeric datetime columns
    datetime_cols = ["last_purchase_ts", "first_purchase_ts", "last_purchase_90d"]
    all_features = all_features.drop(columns=[col for col in datetime_cols if col in all_features.columns], errors="ignore")
    
    # Set product_id as index and reindex to input entity_ids
    all_features = all_features.set_index("product_id")
    final_features = all_features.reindex(entity_ids)
    
    # Identify feature groups for consistent NaN filling
    count_cols = [col for col in final_features.columns if (
        col.startswith("total_") or col.startswith("num_") or 
        (col.startswith("pay_") and col.endswith("_count")) or
        col.startswith("order_status_")
    )]
    avg_cols = [col for col in final_features.columns if (
        col.startswith("avg_") or col.startswith("median_") or
        col.startswith("max_") or col.startswith("min_") or
        col.startswith("std_") or col.endswith("_frac")
    )]
    time_cols = [
        "days_since_last_purchase", "days_since_first_purchase",
        "days_since_last_purchase_90d"
    ]
    ratio_cols = [col for col in final_features.columns if col.startswith("ratio_")]
    
    # Fill NaNs for all feature groups
    final_features["has_any_sales"] = final_features["has_any_sales"].fillna(0)
    final_features[count_cols] = final_features[count_cols].fillna(0)
    final_features[avg_cols] = final_features[avg_cols].fillna(0)
    final_features[time_cols] = final_features[time_cols].fillna(10000)  # Arbitrary large value for "never purchased"
    final_features[ratio_cols] = final_features[ratio_cols].fillna(0)
    final_features["avg_units_per_order"] = final_features["avg_units_per_order"].fillna(0)
    final_features["avg_days_between_orders"] = final_features["avg_days_between_orders"].fillna(0)
    
    # Final cleanup of any remaining invalid values
    final_features = final_features.fillna(0)
    final_features = final_features.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0)
    
    return final_features

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    # Orders that already existed at seed_time
    orders_hist = orders[orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time].copy()

    # Order items of those orders (ts = purchase moment)
    oi_hist = order_items[order_items["ts"] < seed_time].copy()

    oi_orders = pd.merge(
        oi_hist,
        orders_hist[["order_id", "customer_id", "order_status"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )

    win_30 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    win_90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    win_180 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)

    # ------------------------------
    # ALL-TIME HISTORICAL FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    prod_all = oi_orders.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units=("order_id", "count"),
        total_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_customers=("customer_id", "nunique"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        median_price=("price", "median"),
        max_price=("price", "max"),
        min_price=("price", "min"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        last_purchase_ts=("ts", "max"),
        first_purchase_ts=("ts", "min"),
    ).reset_index()

    prod_all["days_since_last_purchase"] = (seed_time - prod_all["last_purchase_ts"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    prod_all["days_since_first_purchase"] = (seed_time - prod_all["first_purchase_ts"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    prod_all["avg_units_per_order"] = prod_all["total_units"] / prod_all["total_orders"].replace(0, np.nan)

    # ------------------------------
    # WINDOWED FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    oi_30 = oi_orders[oi_orders["ts"] >= win_30]
    prod_30 = oi_30.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units_30d=("order_id", "count"),
        total_orders_30d=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_revenue_30d=("price", "sum"),
    ).reset_index()

    oi_90 = oi_orders[oi_orders["ts"] >= win_90]
    prod_90 = oi_90.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units_90d=("order_id", "count"),
        total_orders_90d=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_customers_90d=("customer_id", "nunique"),
        total_revenue_90d=("price", "sum"),
        avg_price_90d=("price", "mean"),
        last_purchase_90d=("ts", "max"),
    ).reset_index()
    prod_90["days_since_last_purchase_90d"] = (seed_time - prod_90["last_purchase_90d"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)

    oi_180 = oi_orders[oi_orders["ts"] >= win_180]
    prod_180 = oi_180.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units_180d=("order_id", "count"),
        total_orders_180d=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_revenue_180d=("price", "sum"),
    ).reset_index()

    # ------------------------------
    # ORDER STATUS (only statuses known at seed_time: delivered requires
    # delivery date already recorded before seed_time; otherwise the order
    # could still change status later, so use conservative approximation
    # based only on what happened strictly before seed_time)
    # ------------------------------
    oh = pd.merge(
        orders_hist[["order_id"]],
        orders_hist[["order_id", "order_status"]],
        on="order_id", how="inner"
    )
    status_known = orders_hist.copy()
    delivered_known = (
        (status_known["order_status"] == "delivered")
        & status_known["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna()
        & (status_known["order_delivered_customer_date"] < seed_time)
    )
    # for non-delivered statuses, current status at seed_time may differ;
    # count only statuses that are stable/final or clearly already true
    carrier_known = (
        status_known["order_status"].isin(["shipped", "canceled", "unavailable"])
        & status_known["order_delivered_carrier_date"].notna()
        & (status_known["order_delivered_carrier_date"] < seed_time)
    )
    canceled_known = (
        (status_known["order_status"].isin(["canceled", "unavailable"]))
        & (status_known["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time)
    )
    status_known["known_delivered"] = delivered_known.astype(int)
    status_known["known_shipped"] = carrier_known.astype(int)
    status_known["known_canceled_unavail"] = canceled_known.astype(int)
    status_known["known_created_approved"] = (
        status_known["order_status"].isin(["created", "approved", "invoiced", "processing"])
        & (status_known["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time)
    ).astype(int)

    oi_orders_status = pd.merge(
        oi_orders[["product_id", "order_id"]],
        status_known[["order_id", "known_delivered", "known_shipped",
                      "known_canceled_unavail", "known_created_approved"]],
        on="order_id", how="left"
    ).fillna(0)

    status_feats = oi_orders_status.groupby("product_id").agg(
        n_known_delivered=("known_delivered", "sum"),
        n_known_shipped=("known_shipped", "sum"),
        n_known_canceled_unavail=("known_canceled_unavail", "sum"),
        n_known_in_process=("known_created_approved", "sum"),
    ).reset_index()

    # ------------------------------
    # REVIEW FEATURES (only reviews already existing at seed_time)
    # ------------------------------
    reviews_hist = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time][
        ["order_id", "review_score", "review_comment_title", "review_comment_message"]
    ]
    oi_reviews = pd.merge(
        oi_orders[["product_id", "order_id"]],
        reviews_hist,
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )
    oi_reviews["has_comment"] = (
        oi_reviews["review_comment_title"].notna() | oi_reviews["review_comment_message"].notna()
    ).astype(int)
    review_features = oi_reviews.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_reviews=("review_score", "count"),
        avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        min_review_score=("review_score", "min"),
        max_review_score=("review_score", "max"),
        std_review_score=("review_score", "std"),
        frac_reviews_with_comment=("has_comment", "mean"),
        days_to_first_review=("review_score", "count"),  # placeholder replaced below
    ).reset_index()
    review_features = review_features.drop(columns=["days_to_first_review"])

    # review coverage: fraction of historical orders that already got a review
    orders_per_prod = oi_orders.groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique().rename("orders_total").reset_index()
    review_features = pd.merge(review_features, orders_per_prod, on="product_id", how="outer")
    review_features["review_coverage"] = (
        review_features["total_reviews"].fillna(0) / review_features["orders_total"].replace(0, np.nan)
    )
    review_features = review_features.drop(columns=["orders_total"])

    # ------------------------------
    # PAYMENT FEATURES (only payments recorded at seed_time)
    # ------------------------------
    if "ts" in payments.columns:
        payments_hist = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time]
    else:
        payments_hist = payments
    payments_hist = payments_hist[
        ["order_id", "payment_type", "payment_installments", "payment_value"]
    ]
    oi_payments = pd.merge(
        oi_orders[["product_id", "order_id"]],
        payments_hist,
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )
    payment_features = oi_payments.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_payment_value=("payment_value", "sum"),
        avg_payment_value_per_item=("payment_value", "mean"),
        avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        max_installments=("payment_installments", "max"),
        num_unique_payment_types=("payment_type", "nunique"),
    ).reset_index()

    dummies = pd.get_dummies(oi_payments["payment_type"], prefix="pay_type")
    oi_pay_d = pd.concat([oi_payments[["product_id"]], dummies], axis=1)
    agg_map = {}
    for col in dummies.columns:
        agg_map[f"pay_{col}_frac"] = (col, "mean")
    payment_type_features = oi_pay_d.groupby("product_id").agg(**agg_map).reset_index() \
        if agg_map else pd.DataFrame({"product_id": prod_all["product_id"]})

    # ------------------------------
    # MERGE ALL FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    all_features = prod_all.copy()
    for part in (prod_30, prod_90, prod_180, status_feats,
                 review_features, payment_features, payment_type_features):
        all_features = pd.merge(all_features, part, on="product_id", how="outer")

    # ------------------------------
    # DERIVED FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    all_features["has_any_sales"] = (~all_features["total_units"].isna()).astype(int)

    all_features["ratio_30d_to_90d_units"] = all_features["total_units_30d"] / all_features["total_units_90d"].replace(0, np.nan)
    all_features["ratio_90d_to_180d_units"] = all_features["total_units_90d"] / all_features["total_units_180d"].replace(0, np.nan)
    all_features["ratio_30d_to_all_units"] = all_features["total_units_30d"] / all_features["total_units"].replace(0, np.nan)
    all_features["ratio_90d_to_all_units"] = all_features["total_units_90d"] / all_features["total_units"].replace(0, np.nan)

    all_features["avg_days_between_orders"] = np.where(
        all_features["total_orders"] > 1,
        (all_features["days_since_first_purchase"] - all_features["days_since_last_purchase"]) / (all_features["total_orders"] - 1),
        0
    )

    # ------------------------------
    # CLEAN AND REINDEX
    # ------------------------------
    datetime_cols = ["last_purchase_ts", "first_purchase_ts", "last_purchase_90d"]
    all_features = all_features.drop(
        columns=[c for c in datetime_cols if c in all_features.columns], errors="ignore"
    )

    all_features = all_features.set_index("product_id")
    final_features = all_features.reindex(entity_ids)

    if "has_any_sales" in final_features.columns:
        final_features["has_any_sales"] = final_features["has_any_sales"].fillna(0)

    # fill NaNs: counts -> 0, ratios -> 0, the rest -> 0; anything left -> 0
    final_features = final_features.fillna(0)
    final_features = final_features.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0)

    # guarantee numeric dtype
    for col in final_features.columns:
        if not pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(final_features[col]):
            final_features[col] = pd.to_numeric(final_features[col], errors="coerce").fillna(0)

    return final_features
